* **Innovatie Bevorderen** – Je ontwikkelt nieuwe of verbeterde technische oplossingen voor complexe kabelvraagstukken, zodat de kwaliteit en uitvoerbaarheid van ontwerpen continu verbetert.
* **Overtuigen** – Je onderbouwt technische keuzes helder richting projectpartners en externe partijen, zodat draagvlak ontstaat voor de gekozen oplossing.
* **Samenwerken** – Je stemt effectief af met engineers, leveranciers en projectstakeholders, zodat ontwerpkeuzes integraal worden afgestemd en projecten voortgang houden.
* **Kwaliteitsgerichtheid** – Je bewaakt normen, richtlijnen en technische eisen zorgvuldig, zodat engineeringproducten voldoen aan de vereiste kwaliteitsstandaarden.
* **Resultaatgerichtheid** – Je houdt focus op tijdige oplevering van technische ontwerpen binnen de afgesproken kaders, zodat projectdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd.

### **Onze uitdaging**


Onshore zorgt voor de veilige, tijdige en betrouwbare realisatie van nieuwe aansluitingen en netverzwaringen op land. Daarnaast onderhoudt deze divisie het bestaande net en optimaliseert zij het gebruik ervan, zodat overal het licht blijft branden.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Test Engineer
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
Tesla is looking for a Manufacturing Test Engineer to develop, commission, and sustain the automated test systems on our battery pack and module lines in Tilburg. You will be responsible for the performance, reliability, and availability of end\-of\-line and in\-process test equipment — from initial specification and build through validation, commissioning, ramp, and long\-term continuous improvement.


Our test architecture is built on modern software foundations, with test sequencing and instrument control developed in Go, backed by Python for data analysis and tooling. You will own tester uptime, first pass yield, cycle time, and measurement integrity, working hands\-on with high\-voltage test systems, data acquisition hardware, and the software that drives them. You will collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Process, Equipment, Controls, Quality, and Maintenance Engineering to close performance gaps and bring new and modified lines online.


This role involves working with high\-voltage live batteries and other hazardous energy, using mandated PPE and procedures. Tesla is a demanding and fast\-paced environment where you will work with a highly motivated team on challenging problems.

 **What You'll Do*** Develop, validate, and commission manufacturing test systems for battery packs and modules — including test hardware, fixtures, DAQ, and test sequences — through FAT, SAT, qualification, and handover to production
* Develop and maintain test software in Go, building and extending test sequences, instrument drivers, and hardware abstraction for automated test stations, with Python for data analysis and supporting tooling
* Integrate test systems with MES and factory data platforms, using interfaces such as gRPC, protobuf, REST APIs, or message brokers, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated software testing for test applications
* Drive improvements in tester uptime, hardware reliability, software stability, cycle time, and first pass yield across the installed test fleet, including support of legacy NI\-based test systems where they remain in service
* Support equipment debugging, qualification, and ramp\-up activities for new and updated manufacturing lines, including on\-site installation and start\-up
* Provide post\-deployment support, performing root\-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions for test system failures and false calls, including analysis of CAN traces and communication logs
* Validate measurement integrity through gage studies, correlation, and calibration management, ensuring test limits are appropriate and test escapes and overkill are minimised
* Conduct pre\-deployment data analysis and Voice of the Customer sessions with Production and Maintenance, build data tools and dashboards that turn test data into actionable engineering decisions, and maintain comprehensive test documentation, SOPs, and training material for Production and Maintenance teams
  

**What You'll Bring*** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with automated test systems in a production or high\-voltage laboratory environment; battery pack, module, or cell manufacturing strongly preferred, with adjacent industries such as EV powertrain, energy storage, automotive, or electronics manufacturing equally welcome
* Proficiency in Go, or strong proficiency in another compiled or object\-oriented language (C/C\+\+, C\#, Java, Rust) with demonstrated ability and willingness to develop in Go, plus working knowledge of Python for data analysis
* Experience developing software that controls physical hardware — instrument drivers, device communication, test sequencing, and state machines — with emphasis on maintainability, structure, and version control (Git); familiarity with gRPC, REST APIs, containerised deployment, or CI/CD is a plus
* Hands\-on experience with high\-voltage test systems, industrial sensors, instrumentation, and data acquisition systems, including electrical safety practices for working with live batteries; experience with legacy NI frameworks (TestStand, LabVIEW) is a plus
* Working knowledge of CAN bus and embedded communication protocols, with the ability to interpret and troubleshoot communication traces
* Experience commissioning and qualifying equipment, including risk assessment, acceptance testing, and structured problem solving (8D, DMAIC, Ishikawa, 5 Whys); ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, with schematic design or 3D CAD for test fixtures a plus
* Exceptional organisation and communication skills in English, an analytical and detail\-oriented working style, and willingness to work shifts, weekends, and occasional international travel as determined by project needs
  

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.  

  

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

jobs.title: Solution Architect (w/m/d)

* Agile \& digitale Unternehmensstrukturen
* Über 20 Jahre Wissen \& Erfahrung in der digitalen Gesundheitswelt
* Mentoring \& Wissensaustausch

#### **Dafür brauchen wir Dich**

* Du unterstützt Kunden, Partner und interne Teams als Technologieexpert:in bei der Konzeption von Lösungen auf Basis der vitagroup Health Intelligence Platform (HIP)
* Du arbeitest nah am Kunden – remote und vor Ort – und entwickelst Lösungen gemeinsam mit dessen Fach\- und IT\-Teams
* Du berätst interne und externe Stakeholder zu konkreten Lösungsansätzen auf Basis unserer offenen Plattformstrategie und zu Interoperabilität
* In Entwicklungsprojekten verantwortest Du die Lösungsarchitektur und begleitest die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit der Projektleitung
* Du baust Prototypen, Proof of Concepts und Referenzimplementierungen, um Machbarkeit früh zu belegen und Entscheidungen zu beschleunigen
* Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der Integration unserer Lösung in bestehende Infrastrukturen und bei der Pflege und Erweiterung der technischen Integrationen
* Du übernimmst im Team flexibel wechselnde Rollen – von der technischen Beratung im Presales über Architektur und Implementierung bis zur Begleitung im Betrieb
* Du hältst Vorträge und Schulungen, leitest Kundenworkshops rund um die HIP und bringst Feedback aus Deinen Projekten in die Produktentwicklung ein

#### **Das bringst Du mit**

* Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Medizin\-)Informatik, Computer Science, eine vergleichbare Ausbildung oder mehrjährige IT\-Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen
* Du bringst Kenntnisse aus dem Gesundheitswesen oder verwandten Branchen mit und hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis medizinischer Zusammenhänge
* Du hast Spaß an der Übersetzung von Ideen und Anforderungen in technische Umsetzungskonzepte und kannst Kunden und Partner von diesen überzeugen
* Du verfügst über Kenntnisse in einer gängigen Programmiersprache, zum Beispiel Java, C\#, JavaScript oder Go
* Du besitzt Erfahrung im Umgang mit klinischen Systemen, z.B. Kommunikationsserver, Krankenhaus\-informationssystem, Laborinformationssystem oder FHIR Server
* Du hast Kenntnisse in medizinischen Kommunikations\-standards wie HL7 v2, HL7 FHIR und openEHR
* Du bringst die Flexibilität mit, in wechselnden Rollen und Projektkontexten zu arbeiten, stellst Dich schnell auf neue Themen ein und reist projektabhängig zu Kundeneinsätzen – überwiegend im  

 deutschsprachigen Raum
* Du kommunizierst technische Inhalte klar, arbeitest strukturiert, lösungs\- und teamorientiert und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch

#### **Über uns**


In der vitagroup arbeiten deutschlandweit über 300 SpezialistInnen Tag für Tag daran, die Gesundheitsversorgung durch fortschrittliche Technologie und intelligente Services nachhaltig zu verbessern. Unsere digitalen Produkte und vernetzten Versorgungslösungen machen heute schon möglich, was viele noch für Zukunftsmusik halten. Mit der Health Intelligence Platform (HIP) schaffen wir eine offene Plattform für die herstellerunabhängige Digitalisierung der Zukunft – ohne die Abhängigkeit von proprietären Systemen.

Across government, cloud technology underpins the delivery of secure, scalable and modern digital services. As organisations adopt cloud\-first strategies, strong architecture is essential to ensure platforms are well\-designed, governed and able to deliver long\-term value. Ofgem plays a vital role in the UKs energy system, protecting consumers and enabling a more secure, fair and sustainable energy future, and a robust Architecture capability is central to this mission.


Ofgem is on an ambitious transformation journey. Within the Digital, Data and Security Services (DDSS) directorate, we are modernising our technology estate and expanding our use of Microsoft Azure as a core platform. This includes building secure, scalable and cost\-effective solutions that support data, AI and digital services across the organisation.


As a Principal Technical Architect (Azure), you will play a key role in shaping how Azure is designed and used across Ofgem. You will define standards and governance, guide technical decision\-making and support delivery teams to build high\-quality cloud solutions. Working across programmes and domains, you will ensure architectural consistency, manage risk and embed architectural best practice across our Azure environment.

### **Job description**


You will be responsible for:

* Defining and shaping Azure architecture standards, aligned to organisational and government frameworks
* Establishing and embedding architectural patterns, principles and governance

A highly experienced technical architect who can shape and guide cloud architecture in a complex environment. You will bring strong Azure expertise alongside the ability to influence across teams.


You may come from a infrastructure, cloud, enterprise or platform background, but you will demonstrate:

* Strong experience designing and delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure
* Solid understanding of cloud architecture, governance and optimisation
* Experience contributing to architectural standards and decision\-making

* Ability to collaborate across teams and guide technical outcomes

Mobile Engineer
Job Location: Stevenage
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world\-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.


With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co\-create solutions that drive enterprise\-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).  



We are seeking a ServiceNow Specialist, to focus on selling our ServiceNow capabilities and offerings. Fujitsu is one of ServiceNow’s Elite Sales \& Services partners and we are rapidly growing our team in North America. Our professional services offerings include consulting, implementation services, managed services and our unique IP on the ServiceNow store The ServiceNow Specialist identifies new prospects by developing and expanding relationships with C\-level functional and IT executives within new logo accounts and partners with existing Account Executives to drive ServiceNOW sales into established Fujitsu accounts.. The goal is to drive net new revenue for the company. ServiceNOW Specialist will have a defined target and associated compensation plan with incentives for achieving and exceeding the targets. The ServiceNow Sales Specialist will be viewed as a client advisor for ServiceNow focused solutions for Fujitsu America Inc.  



**POSITION OVERVIEW**

* Ownership for ServiceNOW targets and associated pipeline
* Thought leadership and expertise within the digital transformation as it relates to the ServiceNow suite of products
* Takes ownership of the sell cycle for new logos including creating overall pursuit plan, building compelling customer proposals,
* Partners with existing Account Executives to coach through the ServiceNOW sales process \& cycle, adding value and providing skills transfer.
* Oversees business activities and processes to ensure that a high standard of professional excellence is maintained among deal team members \- provides "hands\-on" leadership for the team.
* Effectively communicates progress toward goals and objectives, sales tasks, and activities, and clearly describes sales challenges and objections to sales leadership for support and resolution.
* Strong ability to navigate the entire sales process from lead generation to signatures on contracts.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Develop and maintain a sales plan for our ServiceNow Solutions
* Execute as a valued partner within the Fujitsu Sales Ecosystem, aligned with Go to Market strategy.
* Develop trusted relationships with clients through fluency in the ServiceNow technology as it relates to a range of business issues to convert them into revenue generating opportunities
* Devise and execute sales strategies and tactics that result in exceeding sales goals and assist Fujitsu in further penetrating the market. Work with ecosystem partners for ServiceNow in coordination with account leaders and alliance team members to execute
* Advise and educate account team leaders on Fujitsu’s value proposition for the ServiceNow area and develop pursuit strategies and win themes that meet the specific needs of the account/client

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineers (ADA 95)
jobs.description:
Overview:
Expleo is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to support the development, sustainment, integration and deployment of advanced test \& simulation systems operating within secure and regulated environments.

The role covers the full software development lifecycle, including defect investigation, software design and modification, integration, verification, regression testing, release preparation and deployment support.

The successful candidate will work with existing, long\-life software baselines and contribute to the delivery of approved changes, defect resolutions and system enhancements.

Working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, the Senior Software Engineer will provide technical leadership for complex software investigations, support engineering reviews and help ensure that software outputs are technically complete, traceable and appropriately controlled.

The position provides the opportunity to work on complex, mission\-critical systems that support operational training and simulation capabilities.

The role is primarily site\-based within a secure engineering environment and may involve occasional travel to authorised locations for integration, testing and deployment activities.
Responsibilities:
* Develop, modify and maintain software applications supporting test \& simulation systems.
* Lead or undertake software defect investigation, root\-cause analysis and fault resolution.
* Analyse change requirements and produce engineering assessments, effort estimates and technical recommendations.
* Design and implement approved software changes and system enhancements.
* Undertake code reviews and provide constructive technical challenge.
* Support software integration across hardware interfaces, networks, operating systems and external systems.
* Plan and undertake unit, integration, regression and defect\-verification testing.
* Generate objective test evidence and produce clear, auditable test reports.
* Maintain traceability between defects, approved changes, source\-code updates, test evidence and release artefacts.
* Apply configuration\-management and version\-control processes to software and supporting documentation.
* Generate controlled software builds and prepare release candidates.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, including design information, configuration records, test evidence and release documentation.
* Support release reviews, deployment preparation and authorised deployment activities.
* Investigate and resolve complex issues affecting operational or representative test environments.
* Participate in sprint planning, technical reviews, peer reviews, retrospectives and backlog\-refinement activities.
* Provide accurate progress reporting, including deliverable status, risks, issues, dependencies and planned activities.
* Identify and escalate technical risks and issues through the appropriate engineering routes.
* Support transition and knowledge\-transfer activities where required.
* Work collaboratively with software, systems, integration, test, assurance and support teams.
* Comply with applicable quality, safety, security, software\-development and engineering\-governance requirements.


Qualifications:
* Degree, HNC, HND or equivalent qualification in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related STEM discipline.
* Equivalent practical software\-engineering experience will also be considered where supported by relevant technical expertise and evidence of delivery.
* Evidence of continued professional development in software engineering, systems integration, verification, configuration management or a related discipline is desirable.
* Professional registration or progress towards professional registration is desirable but not essential.


Essential skills:
* Strong software design, development, debugging and maintenance skills.
* Demonstrable software\-development experience using **Ada 95**.
* Software\-development experience using **C\+\+ and/or C\#**.
* Ability to understand, modify and review existing and long\-life software baselines.
* Structured software defect investigation and root\-cause analysis.
* Code\-review and peer\-review skills.
* Unit, integration and regression testing.
* Verification of software fixes and production of objective test evidence.
* Software configuration management and controlled change management.
* Version\-control experience using Git, Subversion or an equivalent repository tool.
* Software\-build generation and release\-candidate preparation.
* Ability to maintain traceability across requirements, defects, changes, source code, tests and releases.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Linux operating environments.
* Ability to produce clear technical documentation, engineering assessments and test reports.
* Ability to estimate software\-engineering activities and communicate assumptions, dependencies and technical risks.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability.
* Clear written and verbal technical communication.
* Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team.
* Ability to work within formal engineering\-governance, configuration\-control and security processes.
* Ability to deliver work through sprint\-based or iterative engineering processes.


Experience:
* Significant experience delivering software engineering within a commercial, defence, aerospace, maritime or other regulated engineering environment.
* Experience developing, maintaining or supporting software using Ada 95\.
* Experience developing or maintaining software using C\+\+ and/or C\#.
* Experience maintaining and enhancing operational, deployed or long\-life software systems.
* Experience working with mixed\-language software baselines.
* Experience investigating and resolving complex software defects.
* Experience undertaking structured root\-cause analysis.
* Experience designing and implementing approved software changes.
* Experience working under formal change\-control and configuration\-management arrangements.
* Experience conducting code reviews and technical peer reviews.
* Experience with unit, integration, regression and defect\-verification testing.
* Experience generating objective test evidence and formal test reports.
* Experience producing controlled software builds and supporting release activities.
* Experience preparing release notes, deployment information or other release artefacts.
* Experience integrating software with hardware interfaces, operating systems, networks or external systems.
* Experience producing and maintaining controlled technical documentation.
* Experience working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team.
* Experience communicating technical findings, estimates, risks and recommendations to engineering stakeholders.
* Experience working within sprint\-based or iterative delivery environments.
* Experience supporting software deployment and post\-deployment regression testing.
* Experience operating within secure facilities or controlled engineering environments.
* Experience of test \& simulation systems is desirable.
* Experience of defence, maritime, training or synthetic\-environment systems is desirable.
* Experience using Jira or an equivalent backlog and defect\-management tool is desirable.
* Experience using Teamcenter or an equivalent product\-lifecycle or workflow\-management tool is desirable.
* Experience with Microsoft Active Directory\-integrated environments is desirable.
* Experience diagnosing IP networking, multihomed computer or basic network\-switch configuration issues is desirable.
* Experience using PXE or an equivalent network deployment method is desirable.
* Experience using Symantec Ghost or equivalent system\-imaging and recovery tools is desirable.
* Experience supporting infrastructure upgrades and deployed computing environments is desirable.
* Experience working with technical authorities, design authorities or assurance teams is desirable.
* Experience troubleshooting software deployed across networked computer systems.


What do I need before I apply:
* Must be eligible to obtain and maintain **UK Security Clearance (SC)**.
* Willingness to work within secure defence facilities and controlled environments.

Benefits:

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us:**  

DailyPay is the leader in On\-Demand Pay, helping employers modernize how people get their pay. DailyPay serves more than 1,900 employers and over 6 million employees, including many of the world's most recognized brands. By providing real\-time access to earned pay and financial wellness tools, DailyPay helps employees manage their finances and helps employers attract and retain talent. DailyPay is helping define the future of pay, where money moves at the speed of work.. Learn more at DailyPay's Press Center.

**The Role**
------------


As a Senior Software Engineer, you will work alongside a supportive, high\-impact team of skilled developers to improve how our teams deploy and access services, how data moves across our platform, and how we automate operations to enable future scale. Our teams specialize in developing robust and scalable Go microservices, leveraging a modern tech stack that includes AWS, Docker, Postgres, and Kafka. We are looking for engineers passionate about building high\-quality solutions who thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

**How You Will Make an Impact**
-------------------------------

* **Build Scalable Services:** Design, develop, and maintain robust backend services and APIs that support our evolving platform.
* **Drive Architectural Evolution:** Contribute directly to the transition to microservices by designing clean APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* **Optimize Data Performance:** Enhance database performance and data structures to support high\-traffic, real\-time applications and seamless data movement.
* **Collaborate Cross\-Functionally:** Partner with various teams to ensure technical solutions are perfectly aligned with business requirements and user needs.
* **Champion Engineering Excellence:** Mentor fellow engineers and perform thorough code reviews to drive best practices in Golang.
* **Automate for Scale:** Identify opportunities to automate operations, making it easier for other teams to deploy and access their services efficiently.
* **Solve High\-Traffic Challenges:** Apply pragmatic engineering to handle the complexities of moving data across a distributed platform at scale.

**What You Bring to the Team**
------------------------------

* **Strong Technical Foundation:** 4\+ years of hands\-on software development experience, including at least 2 years working with strongly\-typed languages (Go, Java, C\#, etc.).
* **Microservices Expertise:** Demonstrated experience designing and developing microservices within cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* **Code Quality:** A proven ability to write maintainable, high\-quality, and robust code with a pragmatic approach to problem\-solving.
* **Data \& Messaging Proficiency:** Experience working with SQL databases and a solid knowledge of message queues (Kafka, SQS) and asynchronous processing patterns.
* **Effective Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to describe technical designs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Infrastructure \& Methodology:** Familiarity with cloud\-based infrastructure, basic networking, and Agile/Kanban methodologies.

  

**What We Offer:**
------------------

* Competitive compensation
* Opportunity for equity ownership
* Private health insurance option
* Employee Resource Groups
* Fun company outings and events
* Generous PTO Allowance
* 5% Pension contribution

  

\#BI\-Remote \#LI\-Remote

  

High\-performing cultures aren't built in silos, they thrive on partnership. At DailyPay, we **Commit Together** to an inclusive, professional environment where multifaceted perspectives are our greatest competitive advantage. We recognize that our team members don’t live “single\-issue lives,” and we lean into the wide\-ranging backgrounds and life stages that sharpen our collective decision\-making.


In our high\-trust environment, we empower you to **Challenge Norms**. We’ve created a space where it is safe to ask difficult questions, disrupt the status quo, and share bold perspectives without fear of professional fallout. We believe that by checking our own assumptions and staying curious about the experiences of others, we arrive at better, more innovative results.


We provide the space for you to do your best work through peer advocacy and transparent career development. If you are looking for a culture that values intellectual honesty, celebrates the unique lived experiences of its people, and thrives on collective success, you’ll find it here.


If you require reasonable accommodation for any aspect of the recruitment process, please send a request to peopleops@dailypay.com. All requests for accommodation will be addressed as confidentially as practicable.


DailyPay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion or creed, alienage or citizenship status, political affiliation, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth (or related medical conditions), sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, genetic disorder, genetic predisposition, carrier status, military status, familial status, or domestic violence victim status and any other basis protected under federal, state, or local laws.

They design and develop high\-quality, scalable, and innovative software solutions in a SaaS environment, utilizing cutting\-edge technologies and methodologies, and ensuring they meet the current and future needs of the business and its customers.


### **What You'll Do**


* **Technical Leadership and Mentorship:** Provides technical leadership in project teams, mentor and guide more junior engineers, and contribute to technical decision\-makingPerformance Optimization: Focuses on designing systems for high performance, scalability, and reliability.
* **Stakeholder Engagement**: Works with stakeholders, including product managers, designers, developers, and executives, to align architectural designs with business needs and customer expectations.

jobs.title: Platform Product Owner
jobs.description:
AppyWay is the industry\-leading SaaS solution decarbonising cities by empowering local authorities to digitally manage their kerbside and share kerbside data with fleets and drivers.


Our journey began with AppyParking, an app born from the frustration of finding and understanding parking on the streets of London. During the app’s creation, it was clear that cities lacked shareable, machine\-readable, standardised parking restriction data. So we built the UK’s largest set of standardised kerbside data, in turn discovering the untapped potential beneath everyone’s feet.


Today, we’re Europe’s leading intelligent kerbside platform, helping cities and drivers optimise operations and transition to net zero by uniting parking/loading maps, occupancy data, and cashless payments.


Our impressive client roster includes local authorities such as Edinburgh, Southwark, Lambeth, Haringey, Harrogate, Cambridgeshire, Cornwall, Dorset, Dublin and, more recently across the pond, New York City. Additionally, our apps and API are trusted by tens of thousands of drivers and fleets including Blue Badge innovators Motability Operations.


We are proud to have the support of top investors, including Hyundai Motor Company, Aviva Ventures, Mastercard and Esri. To date, we have raised over £20 million in funding, allowing us to continue building something big from the ground up.


If you’re passionate about tangible solutions to help decarbonise the world, then AppyWay is the perfect place for you. Come and make your mark on a company you can call your own!


About the role
We’re looking for a Platform Product Owner to own our Kerbside Intelligence Platform, also known internally as “The Hub.”


The Hub is a foundational part of AppyWay’s product strategy. It will become the canonical platform for our parking and kerbside intelligence, bringing together data from multiple sources into a consistent, trusted and reusable model.


The Hub vision and strategic direction are set. You’ll own day\-to\-day product delivery — translating that strategy into a clear and prioritised backlog, partnering closely with Engineering and Data to execute it, and ensuring consuming products have the platform capabilities they need to move forward.


This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of product, technology and data, and who can turn complex platform problems into clear, incremental pieces of work that deliver value.

 **Requirements**  

  

What you will be doing* + Execute the product roadmap, backlog and priorities for the Hub Platform.
	+ Work closely with Engineering to implement the kerbside data model, ensuring it meets consuming product requirements and that concepts such as parking assets, geometry, restrictions, tariffs, rights, entitlements and operating rules are represented consistently.
	+ Work with the Data team to define requirements for data classification and standardisation, ensuring data from multiple sources is transformed into consistent, machine\-readable information and meets agreed quality standards.
	+ Own product requirements for data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation and publication.
	+ Work closely with Engineering and Data to define and deliver scalable platform capabilities and APIs that can be reused across multiple products and customers.
	+ Drive the development and scaling of platform APIs, defining contracts, capabilities, consumption patterns and priorities for internal and external use cases.
	+ Identify opportunities to leverage AI and machine learning to improve data classification, anomaly detection, validation, conflict resolution and other data\-intensive workflows.
	+ Work with Data Operations to move towards an exception\-based operating model, where automation handles high\-confidence cases and people focus on complex decisions and edge cases.
	+ Work across Product, Engineering, Data, GIS, Commercial and Operations to understand requirements, manage dependencies and ensure the platform solves real business and customer problems.
	+ Maintain a clear and prioritised product backlog, balancing foundational platform development with the needs of consuming products.
	+ Define clear acceptance criteria, quality standards and success measures for platform capabilities.
	+ Manage dependencies across technical teams and ensure platform changes are clearly communicated, understood and adopted by consuming teams.
	+ Continuously identify opportunities for the platform to remove duplication, reduce manual effort, improve data quality and enable AppyWay to scale its coverage and product offering.


Essential* + 6\+ years’ experience owning technical, platform or data products in an agile environment, with a proven ability to work closely with Engineering teams on complex, data\-heavy systems.
	+ Essential: proven experience with a geospatial product, geospatial data platform or complex SaaS data platform.
	+ A proven track record of owning technical products or platforms, with a good working understanding of APIs, data models, data pipelines and microservices.
	+ Experience designing or managing data pipelines, including data ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation and distribution.
	+ Experience with data classification, standardisation and data quality, particularly where multiple data sources need to be brought together into a consistent model.
	+ Experience working with and scaling APIs and platform capabilities that are consumed by multiple products, customers or third parties.
	+ Strong technical understanding of APIs, integrations, data models and modern cloud architectures, with the ability to work confidently with engineers and architects.
	+ Demonstrable experience identifying and applying AI capabilities to improve product functionality, automation, data quality or operational efficiency.
	+ Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, data practitioners, product teams and senior stakeholders.
	+ Comfort with ambiguity — you can break complex problems into clear scope, sequence work incrementally and make pragmatic product decisions without needing all the answers upfront.
	+ A strong analytical and structured approach to problem solving.
	+ Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams and keeping delivery focused on outcomes.
	+ Commercial awareness and an understanding of how shared platform capabilities can create leverage across a product portfolio.


Preferred* + Experience building geospatial data platforms or products involving maps, location intelligence or spatial data.
	+ Experience with GIS technologies, GeoJSON or spatial databases.
	+ Experience working with complex kerbside, parking, transport or mobility rules.
	+ Experience standardising fragmented datasets from multiple sources into a common canonical model.
	+ Experience with event\-driven data architectures and real\-time or near\-real\-time data processing.
	+ Experience applying AI/ML to geospatial or data\-quality problems, such as feature extraction, classification, anomaly detection or automated validation.
	+ Experience building developer\-facing products, APIs, SDKs or data services.
	+ Experience taking a platform from early\-stage architecture through to adoption across multiple products or teams.
	+ Experience working in SaaS, mobility, smart cities, transport or other location\-based technology environments.

  

**Benefits**  

* Enjoy a competitive salary of £60,000 depending on your profile and experience
* 25 days’ holiday plus all UK bank holidays and accrue additional holiday for each year you work with us up to 30 days total \- it’s our way of saying thank you!
* A hybrid flexible working model: Thursdays in our Covent Garden based office, and the option to work from home the rest of the week (if you that works for you), so that you don’t have to sacrifice your personal commitments
* ✈️ Want to stay a little longer at your dream destination? Have greater flexibility to ‘Work from Anywhere’ for up to a week at time
* Experience true ownership! Everyone at AppyWay owns a piece of the pie through our share option scheme, so when AppyWay does well, so do you!
* Save and plan for the future with our enhanced company pension scheme provided by Royal London. The more you contribute, the more we’ll contribute too!
* We’ll work to protect your compensation from a rapidly changing economy by carrying out an annual Cost of Living exercise to ensure your salary stays ahead of rising prices and interest rates
* Whilst we hope you never have to use it, we offer our entire team Death in Service insurance cover
* Your wellbeing matters to us, gain access to GP consultations, nutritionists, dental advice and counselling on demand
* Access hundreds of perks, discounts, weekly freebies, cashback offers and discounted gym memberships to help with the cost of living changes via PerkBox
* + Working on site? Enjoy a freshly made coffee from our onsite barista and a cold beverage at our bar at the end of the day!
* Everyone at AppyWay has their optimum setup, we’ll let you choose your own laptop, (PC or Mac) and accessories so you can work in comfort!
* Everyone at AppyWay has a clear growth framework and we’ll support you with the appropriate learning and development plan to achieve your goals
* Planning for or raising a family? You can expect to benefit from our inclusive leave options, nursing rooms and a dedicated plan to ensure you are fully supported on your return. You can also benefit from savings on nursery fees through our Workplace Nursery scheme
* We may work flexibly but we’re still a social bunch! Join one of our regular social events, group trips and activities throughout the year

* ️ A polite note to recruitment agencies: Our internal team handles 100% of our Talent Acquisition initiatives in\-house. We appreciate your interest, but external recruiters and agencies should not get in touch regarding this vacancy. Thank you!

jobs.title: Windows Software Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ORGANOX:**


OrganOx is a commercial stage organ technology company dedicated to developing technologies to improve outcomes for patients with acute or chronic organ failure. The company was established as a spin out of the University of Oxford in 2008 and is now part of the Terumo Group. OrganOx is a pioneer in normothermic machine perfusion (NMP). It's flagship platform, the metra®, is available for use in the U.S., Europe, Canada, and Australia. It has been utilized in over 7,000 liver transplants to date to keep donor livers in a metabolically active state outside the body enabling longer preservation times and functional assessment of the organ prior to transplant, leading to an increased number of organs available for transplant. Founded in 1921, Terumo Corporation (TSE:4543\) strives to fulfil its mission of “Contributing to Society through Healthcare” by providing a comprehensive range of solutions in the fields of therapeutic procedures, hospital operations, and life sciences in more than 160 countries and regions.

**Position Summary**

The Windows Software Manager is responsible for leading the design and development of software at OrganOx, for device\-hosted applications and services running on Windows\-based platforms, ensuring delivery of robust, high\-quality solutions for regulated medical environments. The role combines deep technical expertise developing Graphical User Interfaces (GUI), connectivity solutions and implementing cybersecurity mitigations, with strong leadership of teams, projects and cross\-functional stakeholders.


Operating with a system\-level perspective, the Windows Software Manager takes end\-to\-end ownership of the application software, driving alignment with quality standards and regulatory compliance requirements. The role also serves as a key technical representative for OrganOx, engaging confidently with external stakeholders including regulatory bodies, partners, and customers.


This is an on\-site role in Oxford with flexibility.


Listed below are the major responsibilities of the role and a brief description of some of the key tasks to be performed. This list is not totally exhaustive.

**Major Responsibilities**

Under direction from the Director, Embedded Software Development, the Windows Software Manager will be responsible for:

**Resource management**

* Lead and manage a team of Windows software engineers, fostering a high\-performance culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.
* Providing line management, including goal setting, performance reviews, development planning, and ongoing coaching.
* Mentor and support engineers in low\-level design, debugging, and real\-time system development challenges.
* Define and maintain an effective team structure, including roles, responsibilities, operating mechanisms, and supporting infrastructure.
* Plan and manage resource allocation, including headcount planning, role definition, workload distribution, and optimisation of team utilisation across distributed teams.
* Oversee recruitment activities, including identifying hiring needs, interviewing, candidate evaluation, hiring recommendations, onboarding, and probation management.
* Maintain visibility of team capabilities (knowledge, skills, and abilities) and develop targeted training and development plans to address gaps and enhance performance.
* Facilitate clear and effective communication within the team and across stakeholders, ensuring alignment with wider organisational objectives.

**Planning**

* Manage project timelines, resources, and budgets, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
* Guide technical decisions, design reviews.
* Ensure robust software integration with cross\-functional teams
* Drive Agile or hybrid Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) practices.
* Author and execute a roadmap of developments to improve the Software Engineering function, with emphasis on application\-level software.
* Financial forecasting and spend tracking against approved department and project budgets.


**Technical Oversight \& Execution**

* Provide technical leadership for the development of application\-level software for Class II and Class III medical devices.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, including requirements definition, architecture, implementation, testing, and maintenance.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory standards and frameworks, including FDA, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, and other relevant safety standards.
* Establish and enforce high\-quality software engineering practices, including code reviews, architectural governance, and design best practices.
* Contribute hands\-on expertise in complex or critical technical areas when required.
* Drive design principles that support modularity, testability, maintainability, scalability.
* Oversee release quality, defect management, and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Process and tools**

* SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and Work Instructions supporting Software Engineering.
* Selection, development, and qualification of Software Engineering tools and systems.

**Continuous Improvement \& Innovation**

* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in software and medical device development.
* Continuously improve development processes, tools, and engineering practices.
* Drive innovation in IoMT\-enabled medical devices, ensuring seamless integration with cloud and connected systems.
* Introduce automation, performance optimisation, and data\-driven analytics.
* Oversee and approve Software Engineering Design History Files (DHF).

jobs.title: Apprentice IT Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Apprentice IT Support Engineer**

**Level 3**


**ITM Power**

Location: Sheffield

 **About ITM Power**

  

ITM is at the forefront of the green hydrogen industry, designing and manufacturing cutting\-edge PEM electrolysers that are instrumental in global decarbonisation efforts. With over two decades of scientific expertise, we’ve established ourselves as industry leaders in clean energy technology.

 **Our Journey and Growth**

  

As pioneers in green hydrogen technology, ITM is offering the most advanced PEM electrolyser technology in the world. Founded in 2000, ITM Power PLC was one of the first companies of its kind to be listed on the AIM market of the London Stock Exchange. Headquartered in the UK, our state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facility is the world’s first largest PEM Gigafactory in commercial operation, and home to our R\&D and manufacturing. ITM Power Germany is our hub in the heart of the EU. This facility not only houses regional functions including business development and engineering, but also our Aftersales services with the ability to quickly deploy stacks.

 **Innovation and Impact**

  

Our PEM electrolysers are deployed in some of the world's largest green hydrogen projects. We continue to push the boundaries of technology, enhancing cost\-effectiveness and sustainability.

 **Join Our Mission**

  

ITM is in the midst of a transformative phase, focusing on streamlined delivery and operational excellence. We're seeking talented individuals who share our passion for clean energy and our drive to make a tangible impact on the world's transition to net\-zero.



You will be working with an inspiring bunch of people, encouraging each other to be the best we can. We’ve come a long way, join us in the next step of our incredible journey!

  


**What are we looking for**

  

The IT Support Engineer Apprentice will join the IT team and work towards developing the skills, knowledge and experience required for a career in IT support.

  

Working alongside experienced IT professionals, you will provide day\-to\-day support to colleagues across manufacturing and office locations in Sheffield and Europe. The role will involve learning how to diagnose and resolve IT issues, support business systems and devices, and deliver excellent customer service to users.

  

You will also work with external IT service providers and gain exposure to a wide range of technologies, processes and systems. Through a combination of practical experience and formal apprenticeship training, the role offers an opportunity to build technical expertise while contributing to the effective delivery of IT services across the business.



You will be studying for a Level 3 qualification.

 **Responsibilities**

 **1st Line Support \& Customer Service**


* Learn to act as a first point of contact for IT support queries via the Service Desk.
* Assist users with common IT issues under supervision, including:
	+ Windows 11 laptops and desktops
	+ Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint
	+ Printers, peripherals and mobile devices
* Log incidents and service requests accurately within the service management system.
* Update users on the progress of their support requests.
* Assist with routine user administration tasks such as password resets, account unlocks and new starter account creation.

  


**Technical Support \& Development**


* Develop troubleshooting skills by supporting the resolution of hardware and software issues.
* Assist senior IT team members with diagnosing and resolving more complex technical problems.
* Learn how to support key technologies, including:
	+ Active Directory and Entra ID
	+ Device setup, imaging and replacement
	+ Network connectivity and wireless access
* Support the installation and configuration of IT hardware and software.

  


**Working with External IT Partners**


* Learn how Managed Service Providers (MSPs) support business IT operations.
* Assist with escalating incidents to third\-party suppliers when required.
* Help gather troubleshooting information and maintain updates on supplier\-managed tickets.
* Develop an understanding of how internal IT teams work with external support partners.

  


**Site \& User Support**


* Provide on\-site assistance to colleagues across company locations.
* Support remote users with basic IT issues.
* Assist with the setup of equipment for new starters, office moves and meeting rooms.
* Help maintain accurate records of IT assets and equipment.

  


**Security, Processes \& Continuous Learning**


* Follow established IT procedures and service management processes.
* Learn and apply IT security policies and safe working practices.
* Assist in updating user guides and knowledge base articles.
* Complete apprenticeship training requirements and actively develop technical knowledge and professional skills.
* Work towards becoming a confident and capable IT support professional through on\-the\-job learning and structured training.

  


**About You**

 **Knowledge and Experience**

  

* GCSE Grade 4/C or above (or equivalent) in English and Mathematics.
* Basic understanding of computer systems, laptops, mobile devices and common software applications.
* Basic understanding of computer hardware, software and familiarity with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel and Teams.
* Experience of using Windows operating systems in a school, college, home or work environment.
* Experience of working with others as part of a team, either through education, employment, volunteering or extracurricular activities.
* Experience of communicating effectively with a range of people and providing good customer service.

  


**Skills and Abilities**

  

* A genuine interest in Information Technology and a desire to develop a career in IT.
* Good communication and customer service skills.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Good organisational skills, ability to organise work, follow instructions and complete tasks accurately.
* Willingness to learn and complete apprenticeship training requirements.

  


**What We Offer**

  

The opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology in a rapidly growing industry, within a dynamic environment where you can shape the future of energy and work with a team that’s actively addressing global climate challenges. Our corporate culture values safety, integrity and continuous improvement.

  



Salary: National Minimum Wage with wider benefits including:

  

* Contributory pension
* 25 days holiday
* Buy as you earn (BAYE) share scheme
* Birthday holiday
* Holiday Purchase
* Lifestyle Discounts
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Health Cash Plan
* Eye Care
* Gym Scheme
* Life assurance
* EV Car Leasing
* Enhanced Parental Leave
* Our onsite parking includes free electric car charging points

  



We know your career is important to you, it’s important to us too, which is why we also offer opportunities for you to grow and develop your career. If you are looking to join a growing, dynamic business and want to be part of our amazing team we would love to hear from you.

  

Our success is driven by the exceptional diversity of our people. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to promoting and creating a diverse and inclusive environment where we encourage our employees to learn and grow, fuelled by mutual respect in a place where ideas flow and thrive.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Data Platform team owns the development of a robust platform designed to empower all ESO customers to extract, transform, and utilize data from our various applications for their reporting needs. This platform supports multiple tools, including embedded third\-party BI visualizations, a first\-party flat file extractor, and direct SQL read\-only access. We are committed to continuously enhancing these tools by adding new features, overhauling existing functionalities, and delivering the best possible user experience for our customers.

  



The team operates cross\-functionally across the entire organization, supporting data mesh initiatives that enable domain teams to own their data products. We provide the platform and tooling needed to make this ownership seamless and effective, collaborating across time zones and countries to drive innovation.

  



Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will join our Data Platform team, contributing to its mission of enabling our customers and internal teams to fully harness the power of their data to improve community health and safety.

  


**What** **You’ll** **Be Doing** **– the day to day**



You can expect to work as a full\-stack engineer with a focus on front\-end development, helping balance the team’s expertise while being fully capable of contributing to and learning from back\-end development efforts. This role is ideal for someone passionate about creating excellent user experiences while also diving into back\-end systems regularly.

  


**Our Current Stack:** C\#, .NET Core, Angular, Typescript, Snowflake, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Azure PAAS / Serverless, EF Core, SQL Server, Redis, Sonar, Snyk, Cypress, Application Insights, New Relic. This is what you can expect to work with, but we are always open to using other technologies where they add value!

  



Our development engineers lead by championing a culture of personal ownership and customer\-focused execution. We love those who pride themselves in how they contribute through excellent solutions and end\-user experiences, as much as clean and clear code. Our team is made up of highly experienced engineers with a deep expertise across the stack, creating an incredible opportunity to learn from seasoned professionals while contributing your own skills and ideas. We foster an environment where collaboration and mentorship thrive, making it a supportive space to grow and refine your expertise.

  

  

We are an Agile development shop and interact regularly with project stakeholders to ensure that the solutions we build align with customer needs and business goals. To support this methodology, we use regular retrospectives and objective measurements to drive continuous improvement and empower our developers to make informed technology and implementation decisions. As part of the development process, you will be involved in design sessions, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn and teach through peer review of code and completed solutions.

  


**Who You Are \- some of the essential things required to be successful in the role:**


* Three\+ years of experience in software engineering and software design and architecture principles.
* Two\+ years of experience with Typescript and UI development in Angular.
* Two\+ years of experience with C\# .NET.
* A solid understanding of SQL and relational database concepts for reporting.
* Demonstrated experience with Git for source control, branching and merging (i.e. gitflow)

  


**Who You Are – it’s desirable if you have:**


*Experience of some of the following technologies, and a passion to learn and grow across many of the remainder:*


* Logging, monitoring and alerting frameworks (e.g. Application Insights, New Relic)
* OO concepts, design patterns, modern .NET web frameworks
* Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery, or other similar platforms focused on efficient data extraction, transformation, and reporting
* Serverless, PAAS and containerized cloud applications
* Messaging and eventing technologies, (e.g. Azure Service Bus, MQ)
* Working with standardized external file structures (XML, JSON, Parquet, Fixed Length, etc.)

  


**About ESO**

ESO is a fast\-paced, growing data, technology and research company passionate about improving community health and safety through the power of data. We pioneer innovative, user\-friendly software to meet the changing needs of today’s EMS agencies, fire departments, and hospitals. We’re small enough to be nimble and fun, but big enough to be a great place to work. We serve thousands of customers out of our offices across the US, Canada and Northern Ireland.  



**A****re you ready to Make a Difference?**

*ESO is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at ESO regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status or other non\-merit factor.*  



**Data Privacy**

*We disclose your personal information to our private equity sponsor, Vista Equity Partners, and its affiliates, including Vista Consulting Group (collectively, “Vista”), for administration, research, database development, workforce analytics and business operation purposes, in line with the terms of this Privacy Policy. Vista processes and shares your personal information with its affiliates, including other Vista portfolio companies, on the basis of its legitimate interests in managing, administering and improving its business and overseeing the recruitment process and, if applicable, your employment relationship with ESO Solutions UK Ltd. If you have consented to us doing so, we also share your personal information with other Vista portfolio companies for the purpose of being considered for other job opportunities in the pooling system, both inside and outside the EEA. Please find a full list of all Vista portfolio companies at:* *https://www.vistaequitypartners.com/companies/* *and Vista’s privacy policy at* *https://www.vistaequitypartners.com/privacy/**. Where this requires us to transfer your personal information outside of the EEA, please refer to the Privacy Policy for further details on cross\-border transfers. In connection with the recruitment process, your personal data may be transferred outside of the EEA to Lever, Hirebridge, LLC and Criteria Corp., which provide applicant tracking and evaluation services. Hirebridge, LLC and Criteria Corp. have agreed to comply with the EU Standard Contractual Clauses to ensure that your personal information is adequately protected whilst outside of the EEA.*

jobs.title: Intermediate Electrical Engineer Manchester
jobs.description:
Civic is a team of system thinkers in the built environment, creating positive impact for people, places and the planet.


We want our work to have a positive impact on the environment — helping people to live healthier, happier lives while respecting natural limits. We build without destroying, explore without exploiting, and seek to reuse rather than just consume. Above all, we listen, learn, and aim to create a lasting legacy.


Thriving together, today we have a team of over 200 members working across the UK, all united by our creative belief, bringing art and science together to solve problems. Our award\-winning practice has studios in Manchester, London, Leeds, Glasgow, Edinburgh and Dublin.

 **Requirements**  

As an Intermediate/Design Engineer, you will take an active role in the delivery of a variety of building projects across the UK, across a range of sectors including residential, education, commercial development, leisure, net zero/low carbon and regeneration. You will have the opportunity to work alongside industry experts with a variety of engineering and consultancy skills to provide integrated coordinated designs with high profile private and public\-sector clients and collaborators within an award winning practice.


Day\-to\-day task and expectations* Provide engineering discipline design, analysis, calculation and drawing input
* Undertaking engineering design and analysis while being supervised by others, including power distribution, lighting, fire alarm, and communication systems, ensuring compliance with industry standards
* Identifying problems and opportunities, assessing and resolving problems using qualitative and quantitative measures, while being supervised by others
* Conduct feasibility studies, cost estimates, and risk assessments for proposed designs
* Collaborate with project stakeholders, including architects, structural engineers, and contractors, to integrate mechanical systems seamlessly
* Input into the production of high quality written reports on a range of projects
* Preparation, presentation and self\-checking of technical data, drawings and tenders, under the supervision of others and taking part in reviews by others of your work
* Use of industry standard analysis and calculation software
* Being part of internal reviews
* Self\-checking and checking others’ work
* Ensure compliance with applicable codes and regulations, such as IEEE, NEC, IEC, and local building codes.
* Compliance with the duties of Designer under the CDM Regulations 2015
* Compliance with the practice QMS, including self\-checking
* Communicate clearly and openly internally and externally with peers and clients
* Manage your own project timelines, budgets, and resources effectively


This is an opportunity to join a growing Building Services MEP team and contribute to the delivery of well\-coordinated, sustainable and technically robust projects. We are looking for someone who is proactive, organised and keen to develop their electrical engineering capability within a collaborative engineering environment.


Is this you?
You’ll be an experienced electrical engineer with a good understanding of Building Services MEP and a keen eye for technical detail. Collaborative, proactive and organised, you’ll enjoy working closely with engineers and wider design teams to produce accurate, coordinated and well\-presented designs and models.


With a helpful and positive approach, you’ll thrive within an innovative practice that is committed to sustainable design and making a positive impact on the built environment.


Our commitment to DEI
Civic is made up of brilliant people. Each of us is unique, whether in terms of our background, personal characteristics, experience, skills or motivations. And we value our people for the differences they bring to the table. These differences \- this diversity \- is powerful.


Nurturing an inclusive culture helps each of us to benefit from a wider range of these different perspectives, experiences and skills. We believe that this creates a happier, more productive working environment for us all.


We encourage applications from individuals who bring diverse perspectives and are passionate about contributing to an equitable and respectful work environment.

 **Benefits**  

A fair and competitive salary, taking into consideration market rates and your experience level


Flexibility. Our core hours are between 10:30am\-4:30pm, with an early Friday finish!

* ️Hybrid working. Most of our full\-time employees come into the studio 3 days a week


Generous holidays! 26 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays (pro\-rata for part time employees). An extra day when you reach 3 years’ service, and another at 5 years!


Holiday options. Buy or sell a week of holiday each year, or create a sabbatical pot by banking a week’s holiday for 3 years to take a month off on year 4!


Enhanced Family Leave. Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption, shared parental and neonatal care leave pay, plus 2 days paid dependency leave and 1 weeks paid carers leave


Wellbeing support. Mental health first aider support, mindfulness sessions and access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)


Health benefits. Life Assurance, Health Care Cash Plan, Gym discounts and free Eye tests


Sick Pay. 4 weeks enhanced sick leave, plus 2 mental wellness days

* DEI network. An established Equity, Diversity and Inclusion network with regular team activities, plus 2 days of paid volunteering leave each year to support causes close to your heart


Professional Development. Paid professional memberships, 2 days paid study leave (\+ extra for exams), Chartership Preparation Courses, Chartership completion bonus, in\-house ‘Civic Academy’ training, Management Development Programmes and a Mentorship programme for all employees


Financial benefits. Access to our HMRC friendly Workplace Nursery scheme, plus enrolment to our workplace pension scheme


Sustainable travel. Season Ticket Loans \& National Rail Cards, plus two salary sacrifice cycle to work schemes and cycling facilities at all our studios (showers, bike racks etc).

JOB DESCRIPTION AND PERSON SPECIFICATION

**Role Title:** Software Developer

**Reports to (Role Title):** Scrum Master

jobs.title: Product Software Architect
jobs.description:
**Shape the technology behind our products and influence how we build for the future.**  

**Work with talented Product and Engineering teams to solve complex challenges and make smart technical decisions.**  

**Stay close to the technology, from prototypes and spikes through to real\-world solutions.**  

**Bring your ideas, experience and technical leadership to a role where you can make a real impact.**


Main Purpose of the Role:


The Product Software Architect provides architectural leadership across the Mail Metrics product software estate. The role helps Product delivery teams make fast, safe and well\-informed technical decisions while maintaining a cohesive view of the wider product architecture.


Working in partnership with Lead Developers, Engineers, Product, Quality and domain subject\-matter experts, the role shapes target\-state architecture, guides significant initiatives, establishes reusable software patterns and makes key technical trade\-offs and non\-functional requirements explicit.


Architecture is lightweight, pragmatic and delivery\-focused. The role contributes architectural direction, constraints, dependencies, risks and enabling work into the single integrated product roadmap, alongside customer, commercial, operational and regulatory inputs.


The Product Software Architect remains technically hands\-on, using spikes, prototypes, reference implementations and code\-level engagement to prove direction, reduce uncertainty and build credibility. The role develops distributed architectural capability through partnership, mentoring and constructive challenge, while holding clear decision accountability for material cross\-product, high\-risk or unresolved software architecture choices.

  

Location:


Hybrid role based from the Huddersfield or Leicester office, with flexibility to work remotely in line with company policy.


The role requires regular collaboration across the UK, Ireland and Poland and occasional travel to company, customer or partner sites.


Role Description:

### **Product Architecture Direction and Integrated Roadmap**

* Define and evolve the target\-state software architecture for the Mail Metrics product estate across the Migrate, Run, Grow and Transform agenda.
* Maintain a cohesive architectural view across product components, integrations, data flows and shared capabilities.
* Identify architectural constraints, dependencies, technical debt, technology lifecycle risks and enabling work that may materially affect product outcomes or delivery.
* Provide clear architecture input into the single integrated product roadmap, helping Product make informed prioritisation and sequencing decisions.
* Translate product strategy, client needs, operational requirements and business goals into pragmatic architectural direction and deliverable change.

### **Initiative Architecture \& Technical Discovery**

* Guide the architecture of significant product initiatives, making design options, assumptions, constraints and trade\-offs explicit.
* Lead or support architecture discovery across migration gaps, service improvements, product capabilities and strategic initiatives.
* Use spikes, prototypes and reference implementations to validate direction, reduce uncertainty and demonstrate viable approaches.
* Contribute directly to production software on an exceptional basis where targeted involvement will materially unblock delivery, reduce risk or demonstrate architectural direction.
* Take ownership of ambiguous technical challenges, engage the right stakeholders and drive decisions through to implementation.

### **Patterns, Non\-Functional Requirements and Assurance**

* Establish lightweight software architecture principles, patterns and guardrails that enable teams to make safe and consistent decisions without unnecessary governance overhead.
* Identify and shape architecturally significant non\-functional requirements, including security, privacy, resilience, performance, scalability, availability, observability, maintainability, supportability and cost.
* Embed regulatory and compliance considerations into software architecture from discovery through delivery.
* Review significant designs and implementations proportionately to their risk and impact, maintaining coherence while preserving distributed technical design ownership.
* Ensure material decisions, assumptions, deviations and exceptions are consciously understood, risk\-assessed and recorded using Architecture Decision Records or comparable lightweight techniques.
* Make or arbitrate material cross\-product, high\-risk or unresolved software architecture decisions, escalating through appropriate governance where business acceptance of risk is required.

### **Product Technology, IP \& Build, Buy or Partner Decisions**

* Define clear boundaries between strategic Mail Metrics software intellectual property, commodity capability and third\-party technology.
* Guide build, buy or partner decisions by assessing strategic fit, differentiation, time to value, total cost of ownership, integration complexity, security, operability, extensibility, vendor dependency and exit risk.
* Evaluate cloud, automation, AI\-enabled and third\-party technology options as potential approaches rather than predetermined solutions, recommending the option that best balances customer value, risk, cost and architectural fit.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure and Data Architecture colleagues so software designs align with wider strategies while preserving clear accountability between disciplines.

### **Architecture Knowledge, Technical Leadership \& Influence**

* Maintain a purposeful, right\-sized product architecture repository using C4, Architecture Decision Records and other appropriate techniques to show context, boundaries, significant decisions and future direction.
* Establish simple documentation expectations that support consistency, traceability and knowledge sharing without duplicating detailed engineering documentation.
* Mentor Lead Developers and Engineers in architectural thinking, patterns, trade\-off analysis and non\-functional considerations, developing decision\-makers rather than centralising authority.
* Facilitate cross\-component technical discussions where changes span product or service boundaries.
* Influence technical direction through credibility, clarity of reasoning and partnership.
* Communicate architectural options, constraints and recommendations clearly to Product, Technology, senior stakeholders, clients and partners.
* Define and monitor a small set of useful architecture effectiveness measures, such as decision lead time, recurring exceptions, reduction of material technical risk and reuse of shared capabilities.


Required Qualification/Experience/Skills:

### **Essential Skills**

* Significant experience designing, delivering and evolving complex production software in a software engineering or architecture role.
* Strong architecture experience across distributed, cloud\-based, integration\-heavy, event\-driven, messaging\-heavy or high\-volume transactional systems.
* Experience shaping significant product initiatives by identifying architectural options, constraints, trade\-offs and non\-functional requirements.
* Experience evolving established software estates through migration, compatibility, coexistence and progressive change.
* Practical experience using C4, Architecture Decision Records, spikes, prototypes or reference implementations to guide decisions and reduce uncertainty.
* Experience working with Lead Developers, senior engineers and Product delivery teams where technical design ownership is distributed.
* Experience evaluating build, buy or partner options and presenting clear recommendations based on customer value, risk, cost and trade\-offs.
* Experience setting pragmatic technical standards or guardrails and conducting proportionate architecture or design reviews.
* Experience incorporating security, privacy, resilience or regulatory considerations into software design and delivery.
* Strong understanding of distributed software architecture, including component and service boundaries, APIs, integration, messaging, event\-driven patterns and data ownership.
* Strong knowledge of high\-volume asynchronous processing and the trade\-offs involved in designing reliable distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of cloud\-native, containerised and orchestrated application environments and their implications for resilience, scalability and operability.
* Ability to identify and balance non\-functional requirements across security, privacy, resilience, performance, scalability, availability, observability, maintainability, supportability and cost.
* Strong software engineering capability, including the ability to engage credibly in code\-level discussions and contribute directly where targeted involvement adds material value.
* Ability to create purposeful architecture artefacts without unnecessary process or duplication.
* Ability to distil complex choices into clear options, trade\-offs and recommendations for technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong facilitation, mentoring, influencing and stakeholder communication skills.
* Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

### **Essential Behaviours**

* Acts as a collaborative technical leader who develops decision\-makers rather than centralising authority.
* Builds credibility through sound technical judgement, practical experience and direct engagement with engineering challenges.
* Challenges unnecessary complexity and seeks simpler approaches that improve delivery speed and product outcomes.
* Balances strategic direction with pragmatism, favouring evolutionary improvement where appropriate.
* Is open about assumptions, uncertainty, technical debt and architectural risk.
* Takes ownership, embraces ambiguity and drives decisions to a clear conclusion.
* Works constructively across organisational and technical boundaries through influence, clarity and partnership.

### **Desirable**

* Experience in high\-volume, regulated or compliance\-sensitive environments.
* Experience across a multi\-component SaaS or product software estate.
* Knowledge of .NET, Golang and React, or evidence of becoming effective quickly in comparable technologies.
* Experience of legacy modernisation, platform consolidation, customer migration or complex systems integration.
* Knowledge of document composition, workflow orchestration, customer journey or decisioning platforms.
* Knowledge of business messaging and conversational channels such as RCS, WhatsApp, SMS or comparable services.
* Experience designing or evaluating AI\-enabled product capabilities, including data boundaries, failure handling and human oversight.
* Experience supporting client, partner or supplier\-facing technical discussions in an enterprise environment.
* Professional working capability in Polish.
* Relevant professional architecture, cloud or security certification.

24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
