jobs.description:
**Senior Field Engineer (Telecoms)**

**SP Energy Networks, Prenton Way, Prenton, Birkenhead. CH43 3ET**

**Salary from £55,000**

**Permanent / Hybrid (3 days field or site / 2 days remote)**

**Closing Date: 2nd October 2026**

**Purpose**

The position of Senior Field Engineer (Telecoms) is positioned within the Telecoms function of SP Energy Networks. In this role you will provide effective support on the planning, delivery and cost effectiveness of the Operational Telecom infrastructure to the Strategic Telecom Manager. You will act as the delivery authority, supporting the planning of designs on behalf of internal customers liaising with Telecom service providers to deliver their business requirements.


Required to Project and Delivery manage Telecom projects for Adds, Moves and Changes to Strategic Telecoms networks, services must be delivered to customers on time and by the ‘Request for Service’ date prior to being handed to the Operations and Maintenance function completed to levels set by the Design \& Standards function.


We are looking for individuals with experience in managing a Utility sector internal operational Telecom network, with proven experience and expert knowledge. You will also possess good inter\-personal and communication skills with the ability to form effective working relationships with other departments and businesses.


**Responsibilities**  

In this role, you will support SP Energy Networks' Operational Excellence goals and wider business objectives, ensuring that Health, Safety, Security, Environment and Quality (HSSEQ) standards are consistently achieved in all activities.


* **Delivery Management**

You will play a key role in overseeing the safe and effective delivery of Telecommunications projects and operational activities. This will include reviewing site safety arrangements and safe working practices adopted by SPEN Telecoms Contractors, assessing project plans to ensure baseline programmes are realistic and achievable, and providing work instructions to Contractors. You will monitor and review build and civil engineering activities to ensure all work is completed to the required standards.


You will also review and approve CHG requests, ensuring associated activities are completed to the appropriate standard, validate network records, rack and floor diagrams where required, and review end\-of\-job documentation to confirm it aligns with project scope and delivery requirements.


Successful delivery of these responsibilities will be supported through regular site visits and audits.


* **Project Management**

Working closely with customers, you will help develop and maintain an excellent customer experience, responding to requests in a timely manner while ensuring project delivery remains achievable and aligned with agreed project plans and customer expectations.


You will engage with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders across projects and programmes of work to drive successful delivery. This includes collaboration with desk\-based Engineers within Engineering \& Design (E\&D) and Design \& Solutions (D\&S), OTNOM and OTP Contractor resources, end customers, District colleagues, and wider SP Energy Networks teams such as RTS and Cyber. A key aspect of the role will be coordinating with field\-based resources to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time and within budget.


In addition, you will assist with forecasting and reporting activities, supporting the identification and preparation of budgets and helping to maintain accurate CAPEX and OPEX expenditure against project, task and activity budgets. You will also be responsible for managing the field service provision required to support operational telecommunications requirements.


**What you’ll bring**

To be successful in this role, you will hold a degree level qualification, or equivalent, in a relevant technical discipline such as Electrical, Electronic or Telecommunications Engineering.


With proven experience in Project Management, alongside a strong technical background in IP networking technologies, including LAN, WAN and Firewall environments, you will be proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint, with experience in using Visio and Microsoft Project. Experience working with operational Telecommunications networks is also essential.


Possessing a solid understanding of SP Energy Networks HSSEQ standards with knowledge of Telecommunications technologies including Fibre, Copper, Microwave Radio, and Public and Private Cellular Technologies, you will be familiar with MPLS\-IP and MPLS\-TP architectures, as well as PDH and SDH technologies, IP telephony solutions and network synchronisation techniques such as SyncE, ToD, NTP and Phase synchronisation. In addition, you will understand Telecommunications equipment power requirements, including \-48V DC systems, Batteries and UPS technologies.


You will have excellent presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate effectively, influence stakeholders and build strong relationships with both customers and internal teams. As a self\-starter with a proactive, can\-do approach, you will be comfortable working under pressure while balancing the requirements of customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring solution designs remain practical, feasible and deliverable.


Demonstrating a sound understanding of design best practice, Telecommunications business processes and industry frameworks such as eTOM or ITIL, which support the delivery of complex solutions, you will have the ability to quickly learn and master new skills, products and platforms, enabling you to adapt effectively within a fast\-paced and evolving technical environment.


**Whats in it for you**

As well as a competitive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we’ll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.


At ScottishPower, we believe it’s the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family’s wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action – our benefits are designed to help you do just that \- so that you have everything you need to take care of your world – today and tomorrow. That’s why our benefits include:


* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday purchase – perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Share Incentive Plan and Sharesave Scheme
* Payroll giving and charity matched funding
* Technology Vouchers – save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Count us in – pledge to reduce carbon emissions and help fight climate change
* Electric Vehicle Schemes – to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and public transport season ticket loans
* Options to purchase dental insurance, private medical insurance, health cash plan and annual health assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to ‘nudge’ financial wellbeing support
* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more

***Why SP Energy Networks***

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world’s largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make\-up the transmission network – connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It’s a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland’s ambition to be Net Zero by 2044\. And we’re taking it very seriously.


We’re investing \>£10\.6 billion into our transmission network, directly supporting the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.


Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large\-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you’ll fit right in.


We are committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy\-related support. If you need support, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com .

Ten is on a mission to become the most trusted service business in the world. Technology\-driven Product is at the centre of our strategy to create a hugely successful service and business. Millions of members already have access to Ten's services across lifestyle, travel, dining and entertainment on behalf of over 50 clients including HSBC, Swisscard, Visa, Mastercard and American Express. Ten's partnerships are based on multi\-year contracts generating revenue through platform\-as\-a\-service and technology fees.


We have the advantages of already being at scale globally with a critical mass of high\-net\-worth members via stable, multi\-year revenue\-generating contracts. We already have a market leading consumer proposition and credibility (and many integrations) with the leading suppliers/partners across our ‘big 4’ service categories of restaurants/travel/entertainment and luxury retail.


We are debt\-free, profitable and the first B Corp listed on the London Stock Exchange (AIM market).


Our plans are to continue to invest into technology (including AI) to become the main way that our members organise their leisure lives. The next few years will see Ten speed up our progress via our Growth Engine strategy making the next huge steps to achieve our ambitions together.

Ten is currently building a bigger team of AI engineers in London, and as part of those efforts, we’re currently looking for an **AI Engineer** who will play a critical role in designing, building, deploying, and monitoring AI systems that scale across the business and to our millions of members globally.


Your role will involve working in a cross\-functional team, collaborating with product, data and platform teams to produce high quality working software released to a frequent cadence. The team adopts a ‘you build it, you run it’ and DevOps mindset and likes to be hands\-on in all aspects of development. You will be responsible for ensuring the software meets quality through rigorous automated testing and metrics. You will also be responsible for assessing and choosing the right solution for the task at hand whilst considering cost implications and timelines.


If you have a curiosity and passion for AI, whilst a firm grounding in software engineering principles enabling you to build industry leading products, we'd love to hear from you!

**Benefits**  

Our people are at the heart of the business, and we have a culture of recognition and reward \- both through regular appraisals but also annual Extra Mile Awards where we celebrate those who have gone that extra mile in their role. We also encourage all our staff to incorporate their aspirations and interests into their career at Ten and we are there every step of the way in supporting development.

***Rewards designed around you:***

* A competitive salary will be offered depending on experience
* Offer flexible work arrangements including Hybrid work possibilities
* Annual Leave of 25 days per annum and an additional 3 extra days of annual leave in the third year
* One (1\) month paid Sabbatical after every 5 years of Service, without tapping into annual leave
* Employer\-contributory company pension (with a scheme that allows full decision making about what investments are made, levels of risk, ethical funds etc.)
* Lucrative Ten Loyalty Rewards program
* Remote Working Holidays \- Travel and Work for up to 4 weeks per year!
* Access to lots of great travel and entertainment discounts as our clients’ members would!
* Be part of our global, dynamic, and inclusive Team, with diversity at its core.
* Possibility of growth within a dynamic and international company

**Who Are We**


Ten is a leading lifestyle and concierge company helping our clients discover, organise, enjoy and get the most from life. We partner with global financial institutions and other premium brands to attract and retain wealth and mass affluent clients. Established in the UK in 1998 and with over 25 years of experience, Ten operates in over 20 cities worldwide, in over 26 languages, with 65% of our workforce globally distributed and is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange ('TENG'). We were the first concierge business to be awarded the B Corp certification in the UK in 2023\.


Ten’s strategy focuses on four key areas: deliver a world\-class member experience, invest in technology, expand contracts with new and existing clients as well as develop our foothold in new markets by leveraging our market\-leading service proposition.


At Ten, you’ll be part of a global, dynamic, and inclusive team, with diversity at its core and endless opportunities for growth.


Join us and experience a workplace where you can truly thrive. https://tenlifestylegroup.com/ten\-tv/

We encourage diverse philosophies, cultures, and experiences. We appreciate diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for our employees. This idea unites the teams at TEN. All aspects of our relationship, including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or terminate, will be based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Hello! Thanks for stopping by. Let us tell you about all the great reasons to join us here at Yorkshire Water:

  

* We offer a competitive salary, depending on experience (£54,034 \- £63,569\)
* Annual incentive related bonus (£1000 maximum bonus opportunity for the performance year)
* Attractive pension scheme (up to 12% company contribution)
* Development opportunities in line with the Senior Software Developer / Integration Manager progression plan
* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays – plus 2 extra wellness days!
* Life assurance cover of 4 times pensionable salary
* A great benefits package – choose from health cash plan scheme, critical illness insurance, dental insurance, life assurance flex and partner cover.
* Retail savings scheme.
* Online GP service, cycle to work scheme, gym membership discounts and many more!

  

  

**Location: Leeds Valley Park in summer 2026, so you’ll be based there in the future \- Hybrid Working (1\-2 days in the office a week – Leeds).**

  

  

**Work type: Permanent. 37 hours per week, Monday – Friday.**

  

  

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Senior Software Developer / Integration Manager** to join the **Tech** team at Yorkshire Water and be a part of helping Yorkshire Water to provide the best service to our customers. **Could this be you?**

  

  

**What we do:**

  

  

Everyone has an idea of what a water company does. Here in Yorkshire, we make sure that over 5\.4 million people living in the region and the millions of people who visit our region each year, can rely on our services, and have clean and safe drinking water on tap and that their wastewater is taken away. But for us, it’s so much more than this. We look after communities, protect the environment, and plan to look after Yorkshire’s water, today, tomorrow 24/7, 365 days a year. We provide essential water and wastewater services to every corner of the Yorkshire region, and play a key role in the region’s health, wellbeing, and prosperity. New environmental legislation, unprecedented levels of investment and changing expectations from customers means that this is an exciting time to discover opportunities within the water industry. The Tech team are a key part of how we plan to meet the changing expectations of customers and regulators.

  

  

Join us as a Senior Software Developer and help shape the future of our cloud\-based platforms. Working with .NET (C\#) and Azure, you'll design and deliver scalable microservice APIs that power customer\-facing applications. Collaborating with architects and cross\-functional Agile teams, you'll have the opportunity to influence technical direction, champion best practices, and build innovative solutions that make a real impact across the business.

  

  

**Where you fit in:**

  

  

**As our Senior Software Developer / Integration Manager you will:**

  

* Input into the design and lead development of global APIs, and the associated integration whilst maintaining and supporting the IT Programme of work.
* Contribute to the software development standards and governance whilst ensuring that deliverables by you and the wider team adherence to them.
* Contribute to the technical procurement and adoption standards for commercial services and systems.
* As a senior development you will be accountable for Identifying technical tasks from user stories during refinement and create high quality detailed technical lower\-level designs of the technical solution.
* Deliver software services that are robust, reliable and secure in nature, which are technically fit for purpose and meet specified acceptance criteria.
* Keep abreast of changes within their software domain, demonstrating innovation to exploit existing and new technologies to promote reduce costs, manage risk and build resilience.
* Undertake specialist detailed and complex troubleshooting activities within your technical discipline.

  

  

**What skills \& qualifications you will need:**

  

* Strong background in C\# / .NET development (Framework and/or Core) with commercial experience delivering robust and reliable API services within Azure cloud environment.
* Proven track record of driving sustainable performance against challenging business targets, in two or more of the following technical disciplines:
  

\-API development using Microsoft .NET 8 (C\#, ASP.NET, MVC, WCF, etc.)
  

\- MS SQL and database design experience including writing SQL scripts.
* Excellent understanding of Service Oriented Architecture design that integrate correctly
* Excellent knowledge of documentation, testing and release management principles with the ability to prioritise and execute tasks in a dynamic, changing environment.
* Highly motivated and self\-reliant with a personal drive for continuous development you will have proven analytical and problem\-solving abilities and excellent interpersonal skills.
* Extensive knowledge of the system development lifecycle including DevOps processes, CI/CD, writing Unit Tests etc.

  

  

Although we operate 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, it’s important to us that we support flexible working patterns and job share options (when we can), to help you make the best of both your work and home life. We know that juggling childcare responsibilities or getting that ideal work/life balance isn’t always easy! **Do we sound like your cup of tea?**

  

  

If you’re an experienced **Senior Software Developer professional** and want to help us deliver great service for our customers whilst looking after the environment, then be sure to apply today to find out what a career with Yorkshire Water can offer you.

  

  

If successful for the role, you will be required to undergo pre\-employment checks that will include a Basic Disclosure Check, carried out through a Third\-Party Company, prior to commencing employment. Depending on the role, you may also be required to go through the security vetting process for either a Counter Terrorist Check or Security Check clearance. All our roles are subject to a medical questionnaire, and further medicals when required.

  

  

We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring our recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We offer a range of adjustments to make your application experience as comfortable and straightforward as possible.If you have an accessibility need, disability, or condition that requires changes to the recruitment process, please include this information in your application. We will then discuss any reasonable adjustments required.
  

Kelda Group reserve the right to close this position before the published closing date, should the need occur. We therefore advise that you complete and submit your application as soon as possible.

  

  

No agencies please.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**The opportunity**
-------------------


Make Unity run everywhere! That is the mantra of the Embedded OS Platforms team. Users expect stunning interactive experiences everywhere: from in\-car infotainment systems and digital cockpits to touch\-screen kiosks in showrooms and at sporting events. Unity is at the forefront with our scalable, performant runtime engine and Unity Editor workflow.


We are looking for a senior software engineer to join our growing team. The team builds and supports the Unity versions that run on Embedded platforms, like Embedded Linux, QNX and Android Automotive OS. As UX evolves to include multiple screens, layering of 3D content with other applications and rich multi\-touch input, our platform grows to match expectations.


Unity is committed to solving the hardest technical challenges, and this role plays a key part in delivering industry solutions for our customers. You will work with teams across Unity, including industry teams who work directly with customers and R\&D teams responsible for cross\-platform support, systems architecture, libraries, as well as runtime optimization.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------


In your first 3\-6 months, you've ramped up on one of our embedded platforms, shipped your first integrations and bug fixes, and become a trusted contributor in customer\-facing investigations.


Within 12 months, you own a meaningful area of a platform (e.g. AAOS integration) its performance on constrained embedded SoCs and act as a technical point of contact for one of our customers. You guide team wide initiatives with your experience and expertise.

**Your impact**
---------------


You'll be part of a small, senior team with a strong impact. The code you write ships in production vehicles, and your work directly unblocks Unity's embedded and automotive business. You'll help define the technical bar across the team and shape how Unity supports the next generation of software\-defined vehicles.

**Why you'll love it**
----------------------


Genuinely hard problems at the frontier of Real Time 3D and embedded systems. Contribution to cutting edge automotive HMI experiences. A diverse range of responsibilities spanning feature work and customer support. Real ownership, agency and opportunities to grow in a small and senior team that turns the needle and moves the industry forward.

**What you'll be doing**
------------------------

* Bring Unity's Real Time 3D runtime to embedded platforms, like Embedded Linux, QNX and Android Automotive OS, developing new features and integrations that address the needs of industries like the automotive HMI market.
* Build the graphics and windowing layer that powers multi\-screen, multi\-touch digital cockpits and HMIs.
* Profile and optimize KPI like runtime performance, memory, startup/load time and iteration speed of Unity for resource\-constrained embedded SoCs across platforms.
* Partner directly with customers like automotive OEMs as a technical point of contact, investigating issues, removing performance bottlenecks, and setting customers up for production success.
* Raise the engineering bar for a small and senior team through design discussions, code reviews, and automated testing .

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Languages: Proficiency in C/C\+\+/C\# and building scalable feature sets in a large multithreaded codebase.
* Embedded Platforms: Experience developing for Embedded Linux, QNX and hypervised environments.
* Graphics Engineering: Experience developing against Vulkan and OpenGL ES applied to Real Time 3D and UI rendering.
* Performance optimization: Profiling and optimization on resource\-constrained hardware using CPU/GPU/IO tooling.
* Customer collaboration: Working directly with customers on technical issues, with business\-level English.
* Team influence: Become an established senior engineer who guides the team on large cross\-platform initiatives.

**You might also have**
-----------------------

* Experience working with or developing Real Time 3D game engines (Unity, Unreal, Godot).
* Hands\-on game development experience.
* Experience developing for embedded and automotive SoC (Qualcomm SA8295/SA8775P, NXP i.MX8/i.MX95, NVIDIA Jetson/DRIVE Orin).
* Experience working on automotive HMI (cluster, infotainment, ADAS, map navigation).
* Android platform: Hands\-on AAOS or AOSP development experience on the platform layer, experience integrating into the Android lifecycle as well as using the Android compositing stack (SurfaceFlinger, HWComposer, Gralloc, EGL).

**Gross pay annually:**

Lithuania: 54,200 \- 81,400 EUR  

UK Zone A 55,700 \- 83,500 GBP


UK Zone B 63,700 \- 95,500 GBP

  

This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.

The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.*

At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well\-being and work\-life balance.

While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance \| Commute subsidy \| Employee stock ownership \| Competitive retirement/pension plans \| Generous vacation and personal days \| Support for new parents through leave and family\-care programs \| Office food snacks \| Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support \| Employee Resource Groups \| Global Employee Assistance Program \| Training and development programs \| Volunteering and donation matching program

Unity \[NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. jobs.title: Software Developer (React & TypeScript)
jobs.description:
**Enjoy solving problems and learning something new? Join our friendly team and help build software that makes life easier for care home staff.**

**Home based, with occasional office attendance for workshops and socials.**

**The Company**

Hello! We’re CoolCare, and we build software for the care sector. Founded in 1999, and with decades of experience building and operating care homes through our sister companies, we understand the difference good software can make. We’re passionate about using technology to make care home teams’ working lives easier.

This role will sit within **LNT Connect**,a new, dedicated development team within CoolCare. The team will build and support digital products for other businesses within the LNT Care Developments Group, helping teams work more consistently, manage important processes and make better use of their information.

Although LNT Connect has its own dedicated work, you’ll be part of the wider CoolCare team and benefit from our development experience, working practices and supportive culture.

**What do people like about working here?**

Our values are a good reflection of how we work:

· **We’re passionate and knowledgeable.** We care about the work we do and enjoy learning more about our products and the people who use them.

· **We’re approachable and helpful.** We share ideas, support each other and know that no one is too important to lend a hand.

· **We’re agile and smart.** We’re always looking for practical ways to improve things and solve problems.

· **We’re fair and respectful.** We trust people to work independently, speak honestly and treat colleagues and customers well.

As a team, we are motivated by our mission and knowing our work benefits care homes across the country.

**The Position**

You’ll help develop and maintain business web applications built using React and TypeScript and hosted in AWS and Firebase. These are practical, data\-driven systems involving user accounts, forms, workflows, reporting and access controls.

Working with colleagues across CoolCare, LNT and Crystal Care, you’ll turn real operational needs into useful, straightforward features. You’ll investigate issues, improve existing functionality and help keep our applications reliable and secure.

You’ll be involved throughout the development process, from understanding what users need through to development, testing and release. As part of a small new team, you’ll also have plenty of opportunity to influence how we approach the code, data, configuration and longer\-term development of the products.

We’re looking for someone with experience in building applications that manage data and business processes. Experience limited to brochure websites, landing pages or CMS page building will not be sufficient for this role.

**What we are looking for**

**Personal Skills**

* You care about doing things well and can make practical decisions.
* You can work independently, communicate clearly and know when to ask for help.
* You enjoy understanding what users need and making things easier for them.
* You enjoy learning new approaches and are open to using AI tools to improve the speed and quality of your work, while checking their output and taking responsibility for the results.
* You’re comfortable joining a small, developing team and helping to shape how it works.

**Technical Skills**

* Experience building and maintaining production web applications using modern frontend frameworks and languages, including React and Typescript.
* Experience using cloud services for application hosting, authentication and server\-side processing.
* Familiarity with deployments, permissions, logging and troubleshooting in cloud environments.
* Experience working with relational and/or document databases, including data modelling, querying and secure access controls.
* Familiarity with Agile working, version control, code reviews and automated testing.

**Desirable experience**

Experience with any of the following would be useful:

* Experience with other web application technologies, such as Vue.js, Angular, Node.js or .NET.
* Firebase, including Firestore, Authentication, Hosting and Functions.
* AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.
* SQL Server or Azure SQL.
* Configurable forms, reports or workflows.
* Building or integrating APIs.
* CI/CD and deployment automation.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to support development, debugging, testing or code review.
* Handling sensitive personal data or developing software for the care sector or similar.

**Application Process**

Our two\-stage process starts with a conversation about your experience and the role, followed by a practical programming session where you'll work through a small application with one of our developers. We expect to hold both stages during a single visit to our office.

Pay: £40,000\.00\-£45,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Garforth LS25

jobs.title: Senior Integration and Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Location: Bristol or Manchester hybrid (regular travel to partner sites across the UK and Ireland as needed)  

Role Type: Permanent (full\-time preferred, flexible working considered)

  

About PACT Solutions:


PACT Solutions is a specialist management and digital transformation consultancy working exclusively with higher education institutions across the UK.


We help universities solve complex challenges across strategy, student records, data, change and delivery. Our work often sits at the heart of major institutional transformation, helping partners improve the student journey, modernise operations and deliver change more effectively.


PACT has grown quickly and is now entering its next phase. We are moving from a founder\-led boutique consultancy into a more scaled and structured business, while protecting the quality, culture and partner focus that have made us successful.


Our culture is crucial to our success. Each day, our team significantly contributes to our business and that of our partners.


We combine the agility and collaborative spirit of a close\-knit consultancy with the credibility, structure, and professionalism needed to deliver meaningful digital transformation.


Our values sit at the heart of everything we do and are core to our business.

  

Partnership: We work with you, not for you.


Integrity: We do the right thing, even when it requires difficult conversations.


Curiosity: We dig deeper to uncover what will truly deliver value.


Transformation: We focus on outcomes that create lasting, measurable improvement.

  

The Role


We are looking for a Senior Integration and Solution Architect to own the architecture of data integration solutions across our higher education partners. You will define the integration framework: the principles, patterns, standards and technical decisions that determine what is built and how it is built.


This is an architecture role, not a day\-to\-day delivery management role. Working alongside colleagues who lead programme and technical delivery, you will provide the architectural direction and assurance that enable secure, resilient and maintainable integrations across complex transformation programmes.


You will combine strong consulting skills with practical experience of Azure Integration Services and software engineering. You will shape target\-state architectures, guide solution design and support teams to apply consistent, reusable approaches.

  

Purpose of the role


To support the delivery of effective, practical and people\-centred change activity that helps PACT’s partners adopt new systems, processes and ways of working successfully.

  

Key Responsibilities


1\. Integration and solution architecture

* Own the integration architecture for assigned partner programmes and shape the target\-state integration landscape.
* Define and evolve integration principles, reference architectures, patterns, standards and reusable components.
* Translate business, data and operational requirements into clear solution architectures, design decisions and technical roadmaps.
* Set the approach to API design, data contracts, message design, asynchronous processing, error handling, security, observability and resilience.
* Assess architectural options and technical trade\-offs, providing clear recommendations to partners and delivery teams.


2\. Solution design and technical assurance

* Design practical, scalable and maintainable integrations using Azure Integration Services, including Azure Service Bus, APIs and related Azure services.
* Provide architectural assurance at key design, build, test and deployment points, ensuring solutions conform to agreed standards.
* Review technical designs, code and documentation to improve consistency, quality and long\-term supportability.
* Support the resolution of complex integration issues and design risks, focusing on root cause and sustainable architectural outcomes.


3\. Stakeholder and consulting leadership

* Lead architecture workshops, discovery sessions and design forums with senior business and technical stakeholders.
* Build trusted relationships with stakeholders up to Head of Service and senior manager level.
* Explain complex technical concepts in clear business language and challenge constructively where decisions create avoidable risk or compromise.
* Work closely with programme, product, data and technical delivery colleagues so architectural decisions are understood and actionable.


4\. Capability development

* Develop PACT's integration framework, methodologies, standards, reusable assets and propositions.
* Coach consultants and engineers in sound integration design and engineering practice.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and the continued development of PACT's Data Integration capability.


What we offer

* + The opportunity to shape integration architecture across major higher education transformation programmes.
* + Work with Azure Integration Services, Azure Service Bus, Python and .NET in complex enterprise environments.
* + Development of consulting, architecture and technical capability.
* + A clear progression path through PACT's consulting career pathway, including Principal\-level opportunities.
* + The opportunity to shape PACT's Data Integration capability.


This role sits at the Senior Consultant within PACT’s consulting career pathway (Analyst Consultant Senior Consultant Lead Principal), providing a strong foundation to develop core consulting and delivery skills.

 **Requirements**  

Essential experience

* Significant experience as an Integration Architect, Solution Architect or similar senior architecture role in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong integration architecture capability, including API design, messaging patterns, asynchronous processing, event\-driven integration and data contracts.
* Ability to define architectural principles, standards, patterns and reusable components, and apply them across multiple systems and teams.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Integration Services, particularly Azure Service Bus, APIs and related Azure services.
* Strong Python and/or .NET development capability, with experience building or assuring production\-grade integration services.
* Ability to design secure, scalable and maintainable integrations, including observability, error handling, resilience and supportability.
* Experience facilitating architecture workshops, communicating technical trade\-offs and influencing senior stakeholders.
* Experience reviewing and assuring technical designs, documentation and engineering outputs.

  

Desirable

* Experience within higher education.
* Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as SIS, ERP, CRM and VLE systems.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, source control and automated testing.
* Experience in consultancy or transformation environments.

  

**Benefits**  

PACT offers a flexible and supportive approach to work, including hybrid and flexible working arrangements. Our benefits package includes enhanced pension contributions, an annual bonus and enhanced parental leave, helping our people balance a rewarding career with the commitments that matter to them.

jobs.title: Senior GenAI Engineer (UK)
jobs.description:
**Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning**

Pigment is the AI\-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature\-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.

With a team of 600\+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top\-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.  


Pigment is seeking an experienced GenAI Engineer with a strong CS background and experience with Large Language Models (LLM) to join our innovative and fast\-paced team.
In this role, you will work on cutting\-edge NLP projects and play a crucial part in developing and refining our product. If you are passionate about machine learning, have a strong background in natural language processing, and thrive in a collaborative and high\-impact environment, we'd love to hear from you!

**What you will do :**

jobs.title: Senior AI Solutions Architect - London
jobs.description:
**About Neo4j:**
Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise\-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy\-to\-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.


Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.


**Our Vision:**
At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.


As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.


**Job Summary:**
================

  

As a Senior AI Solutions Consultant at Neo4j, you will drive transformative change by designing, building, and deploying innovative solutions that combine the power of graph databases and AI. You'll work hands\-on to develop scalable, production\-grade solutions while acting as a trusted advisor to strategic customers, translating complex data challenges into tangible business value. This involves collaborating closely with customer executives and technical leaders to understand their specific needs and then leveraging your expertise in graph technologies, LLMs, and AI orchestration frameworks to develop bespoke, production\-ready AI applications grounded in real\-world context using Neo4j Knowledge Graphs.

  

Providing hands\-on consulting and technical expertise for customer engagements will be central to your role. You'll collaborate with Neo4j's most strategic customers on projects that revolutionize their businesses. You'll also collaborate with key Neo4j cloud partners to deliver joint consulting services, offering technical guidance and best practices.


**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================


Solution Architecting:


* You will work with customer technical leads, customer executives, and partners to manage and deliver successful implementations of Graph\+GenAI solutions becoming a trusted advisor to decision\-makers throughout the engagement.
* You will propose solution architectures and manage the deployment of Graph\+GenAI solutions according to complex customer requirements and implementation best practices.
* You will work directly with customers to understand their business objectives and translate them into AI\-powered solutions that leverage graph databases and LLMs. This includes gathering requirements, understanding existing data landscapes, and identifying opportunities to apply graph\-based AI to solve business challenges.

You will interact with customer stakeholders to manage project scope, priorities, deliverables, risks and issues, and timelines for successful customer outcomes.  
* 

Solution Engineering:


* You will develop, test, and deploy production\-ready AI applications that integrate graph databases with LLMs and orchestration frameworks. This involves writing production\-level code, optimizing for performance and scalability, and ensuring seamless integration with customer systems.
* Continuously evaluate and improve the performance, scalability, and efficiency of deployed AI applications, incorporating new techniques and technologies as they emerge.
  

Education \& Enablement:


* You will work with other teams at Neo4j (Product and Marketing) to influence the roadmap and provide insights from the field, and package approaches, best practices, and lessons learned into thought leadership, methodologies, and published assets.
* You will share your expertise internally with other Neo4j teams and also with customers through workshops, training sessions, and documentation to empower them to effectively utilize, maintain, and reproduce the AI solutions you deliver.
* Maintain continuous learning and stay up\-to\-date with the rapidly evolving GenAI landscape, proactively seeking knowledge of new trends and technologies.

**Required Qualifications:**
============================

  

* **Enterprise Application Development**: 5\+ years of experience in designing and developing enterprise\-class applications, demonstrating a strong understanding of software development lifecycle principles.
* **LLM Proficiency**: 2\+ years of Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and integrating LLMs into applications. Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of different LLM providers and their strengths and limitations (e.g., OpenAI’s GPT and O families, Anthropic’s Claude family, Google’s Gemini, xAI’s Grok, as well as open\-source LLMs like LLama, DeepSeek, and Mistral).
* **Programming Proficiency**: Competence and hands\-on experience in at least one of the following languages: Java, JavaScript, Python, or C\#. Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code is essential.
* **Deployment and Version Control**: Hands\-on experience with deployment software on major platforms, such as Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes, and proficiency in source control software, including Git and SVN.
* **Cloud Computing Expertise**: Practical experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and demonstrated proficiency in deploying applications within cloud environments.
* **Generative AI Ecosystem Knowledge**: Deep understanding of the generative AI ecosystem, including AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Llama Index, Haystack) and cloud provider AI offerings (e.g., AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, Azure Machine Learning).
* **Data Expertise**: Strong foundation in data engineering, data analytics, or data science, with the ability to work effectively with various data types and sources. Experience using big data technologies (e.g. Hadoop, Spark, Hive) and database management systems (e.g. SQL and NoSQL).
* **Graph Database Expertise**: Deep understanding of graph database concepts, data modeling, and query languages (e.g., Cypher). Demonstrate hands\-on experience with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Neptune, TigerGraph) or triple stores (e.g., Ontotext, Stardog).
* **Communication and Collaboration Skills**: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with customers and internal teams, fostering strong working relationships.
* **Problem\-Solving and Analytical Abilities**: Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities to address complex technical challenges and design effective AI solutions.
* You will have the ability to travel up to 50% of the time for customer engagements.
**Why Join Neo4j?**
Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.


* Neo4j is one of the fastest\-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.
* Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world\-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well\-funded database companies in history.
* 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others.
* Co\-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
* Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
* A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.

Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet all the qualifications. **If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we’d encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application.** At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues.


One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career\-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.


**Neo4j Values:**
Neo4j is a Silicon Valley company with a Swedish soul. We foster collaboration and each of us is empowered to contribute and put our innovative stamp on projects. We hire candidates who reflect the following Neo4j core values:

Job Introduction

This is a really exciting opportunity for an experienced Landscape Architect to join our Design Team and support the Capital Projects Service in delivering the Council’s construction, public realm, regeneration and environmental improvement programmes!


The successful candidate will independently lead and contribute to landscape\-led and multidisciplinary projects from feasibility and design through procurement, construction, completion and operation. The role requires strong design ability, sound professional judgement, excellent communication and the capacity to manage multiple projects and competing demands.

**Your new role**


Sitting within the Housing, Neighbourhoods and Building Services directorate, you will report to the Landscape Architect Team Leader and support the Principal Architect in delivering the Council’s capital projects and professional design services. The Design Team is multidisciplinary and includes architects and landscape architects. The team works closely with building surveyors, quantity surveyors, engineers, construction inspectors, project managers and internal and external consultants to deliver project outcomes.


The team provides services across the Council and to external organisations. Clients and stakeholders may include Housing, Education, Planning, Highways, Parks, Regeneration, Culture, Leisure, Public Health and Property services, together with schools, academy trusts, NHS bodies, charities and neighbouring authorities. Projects may include schools, housing estates, parks, streets and public realm, civic and operational property, regeneration sites, heritage settings and externally commissioned work. You will balance design quality and environmental outcomes with statutory, financial, operational, political and community requirements.


Please see the full job profile attached at the bottom of this page for all details of what the role will involve!

**Who is the person?**


The ideal candidate is someone who:

* Holds an undergraduate honours degree or postgraduate degree, or equivalent, in landscape architecture or a closely related discipline that provides the professional knowledge required for the role.
* Chartered Membership of the Landscape Institute is preferred but is not essential. Applicants who are not chartered must demonstrate extensive relevant professional experience and competence equivalent to undertaking the full duties of the role independently, with willingness to pursue chartership.
* Have at least three years of relevant professional experience and a record of independently delivering significant or medium\-scale landscape, public realm, regeneration or environmental improvement projects.
* Demonstrate strong landscape design ability and the capacity to analyse a place, identify constraints and opportunities, develop creative options and communicate a coherent design response.
* Have expert knowledge of landscape planning, hard and soft landscape design, construction detailing, specification, procurement, contract administration, construction and aftercare.
* Have practical knowledge of planning and environmental requirements, including biodiversity net gain, sustainable drainage, green infrastructure, accessibility, trees, ecology, heritage and relevant health and safety duties.
* Have experience of working within and, where required, leading multidisciplinary professional teams and coordinating the input of clients, consultants, contractors and statutory bodies.
* Have experience of preparing tender information, assessing submissions, administering construction contracts, inspecting works, managing defects and protecting the client’s contractual position.
* Demonstrate commercial awareness and experience of project budgets, professional fees, cost planning, tender evaluation, valuations, change control, forecasting, risk management and value for money.
* Have excellent written, verbal, visual and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear reports and presentations, chair meetings, consult communities, negotiate and resolve disagreement.
* Be able to build trusted relationships with internal and external clients, understand their requirements, manage expectations and keep stakeholders informed throughout the project lifecycle.
* Be organised, resilient and comfortable managing multiple projects, deadlines and changing priorities while maintaining accuracy, professional standards and attention to detail.
* Be proficient in AutoCAD and relevant design, visualisation and presentation software, together with NBS or equivalent specification systems and Microsoft 365 applications.

Portsmouth City Council is a unique organisation, committed to making a difference, and is guided by core values that set who we are as people, what we stand for, and how we act.


We are committed to our values of respect, integrity, collaboration, inclusivity and being people\-focussed. These values set out how we can contribute to the success of the council and our own success as individuals. Learn more about our values and behaviours.

Working closely with Digital Product Owners, UX Designers, Digital Marketing teams, and technical stakeholders, you will deliver scalable, high\-performing digital solutions that provide exceptional customer experiences while supporting business objectives.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both project\-based development and ongoing support of business\-critical digital platforms.

**Above all else, we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life. It’s this guiding vision that influences everything we do at HCA UK. From the CEO to the colleagues on the floor we all have a part to play in delivering exceptional care to our patients. Others may think this is just a role in Digital IT, but to us, you’ll be part of a wider team with a unique sense of purpose, one that helps improve lives on a daily basis.**

**What you’ll do:**

* Design, develop and maintain websites and digital applications using Sitecore.
* Build reusable Sitecore components, templates, rendering items and workflows.
* Develop custom integrations between Sitecore and third\-party systems, APIs, CRM platforms and Microsoft services.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle from requirements gathering through QA, deployment and support.
* Provide ongoing support, troubleshooting, upgrades and enhancements for existing Sitecore environments.
* Collaborate with UX, Digital Marketing and technical teams to deliver personalised digital experiences and continuous platform improvements.

**What you’ll bring:**

* Experience developing at the Sitecore component level on both the Microsoft stack and the NextJS stack.
* Experience developing RESTful APIs, system integrations and working with SQL Server.
* Experience using modern development pipeline practices including GitHub, Git actions, CI/CD, peer review and DevSecOps tooling.

Glasgow

ORE Catapult \| Full Time \| Hybrid Working

ORE Catapult is the UK's leading innovation centre for offshore renewable energy, accelerating the technologies needed to deliver a net zero future.

  

Working with industry, academia and government, we help develop, test and commercialise innovative technologies that support the growth of offshore wind, wave and tidal energy, whilst strengthening the UK supply chain and driving economic growth.

 **The Role**

  

We're looking for a **Project Engineer** to join our Research \& Engineering team.

  

This is an exciting opportunity for an engineer with a passion for innovation and technology development to support the delivery of cutting\-edge renewable energy projects across the offshore renewables sector.

  

As a Project Engineer, you'll lead the scoping, development and delivery of projects with ORE Catapult and external partners. You'll provide technical expertise across a range of engineering activities including mechanical design, analysis and simulation, technology development, and supply chain innovation support.

  

Working within our Engineering Projects team, you'll play a key role in delivering commercial, collaborative and research projects that help address some of the sector's most pressing engineering challenges. You'll work closely with industry partners, technology developers and stakeholders to develop innovative solutions that support the deployment and growth of offshore renewable energy technologies.

 **What You'll Be Doing**

  

* Leading the delivery of commercial and collaborative projects within ORE Catapult's Offshore Renewables portfolio.
* Providing technical leadership and subject matter expertise across engineering projects.
* Managing work delivered by engineers and external consultants to meet project objectives and quality standards.
* Supporting the development, scoping and initiation of new projects and opportunities.
* Working closely with internal teams, technology developers and supply chain partners to deliver project outcomes.
* Leading and contributing to industry workshops and stakeholder engagement activities.
* Producing high\-quality technical reports, analysis and project documentation.
* Supporting quality assurance, health and safety, environmental and quality management processes.

 **About You**

  

You'll be an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and working in an innovation\-focused environment. You'll be comfortable managing multiple projects and collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders to deliver impactful engineering solutions.

  

You'll ideally have:

  

* A degree in a relevant engineering or scientific discipline such as Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Marine Engineering, Oil \& Gas Engineering or Naval Architecture.
* Around five years' relevant industry experience or demonstrable equivalent experience.
* Experience delivering technical engineering projects and activities successfully.
* Experience managing stakeholder relationships and engaging with industry partners.
* Knowledge of floating wind and the wider offshore wind industry.
* Experience using CAD, mechanical analysis and numerical modelling software.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication and organisational skills.
* The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* A proactive, innovative and collaborative approach to engineering challenges.

 **Desirable**

  

* Knowledge of offshore renewable energy supply chains.
* Offshore field experience within offshore renewables or a related industry.

 **Why Join Us?**

  

This role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of offshore renewable energy innovation, helping to develop technologies that support the UK's transition to net zero.

  

You'll work alongside leading engineers, researchers and industry partners on projects that make a tangible impact across the offshore renewable energy sector. From technology development and engineering analysis to supply chain innovation and industry collaboration, you'll help shape the future of renewable energy in the UK and beyond

jobs.title: Structural Engineer for calculations (for projects in Sweden)
jobs.description:
### **Job Description**


In Sweden we currently have 80 Structural building engineers working within Public and Commercial places. We work with a wide scope of assignments ranging from the planning\-stage to execution of drawings for final production. In general we work in 10\-15 persons teams assigned to different projects, our engineers have a typical workload of 2\-4 ongoing projects.


Typical projects are within the segments airports, hospitals, offices, schools, public transportation, high security facilities, defense, retail and residential.


**Our Service Areas\-you will become part of one of the described Teams:**


Region East \- Structural Engineering


Region East consists of approximately 35 structural engineers located across Stockholm, Norrköping, Linköping and Motala. The organization is characterized by a strong senior profile, with the majority of its engineers having 10\-35 years of experience in structural engineering and building design.


The region delivers structural engineering services across a broad range of sectors, including healthcare facilities, schools, airports, sports facilities, defense, residential developments, office buildings, energy facilities, and transportation/infrastructure projects. Clients are primarily public sector organizations, such as municipalities, regional authorities, government agencies, and public property owners, complemented by collaborations with contractors and private developers.


With offices strategically located in both the Stockholm area and Östergötland, Region East combines extensive technical expertise with strong local presence and the capacity to manage complex multidisciplinary projects throughout Sweden. The region is led by Joakim Tornberg (Market area manager), Daniel Warminski (SAM Stockholm South), Victor Prevé (SAM Stockholm North), and Peter Svensson (SAM Östergötland).


Region West \- Structural Engineering


Region West consists of approximately 30 structural engineers based in Göteborg, Skövde and Alingsås. The organization is characterized by a strong senior profile, with the majority of its engineers having 10\-30 years of experience in structural engineering and building design.


The region delivers structural engineering services across a broad range of sectors, including healthcare facilities, schools, residential developments, defense projects, and energy\-related facilities. Clients primarily comprise public sector organizations, such as municipalities and regional authorities, as well as major construction companies and contractors.


With offices strategically located across western Sweden, Region West combines extensive technical expertise with strong local presence and the capability to support projects ranging from complex public buildings and healthcare facilities to residential and energy\-sector developments. The region is led by Karin Stagemyr (Market area manager), Keyvan Zeidi (SAM Skövde/Alingsås) and Magnus Clase (SAM Göteborg).


Region North – Structural Engineering


Region North consists of a team of 15 structural engineers, the majority of whom have 5\-15 years of experience in the industry. The unit is located in the northern part of Sweden with offices in Östersund, Umeå, Örnsköldsvik, Mora, Lycksele and Sollefteå. Typical projects for this unit include hospitals, schools, residential and defense facilities. Clients are often public\-sector organizations such as municipalities or government organizations. The region is led by Rasmus Brink (Market area manager) and Joel Melander (SAM).


**Based on your experience and qualifications we will recognize you at the position of assistant structural designer or junior structural designer.**


Your key responsibilities


* Develop structural designs for buildings
* Perform structural calculations and analysis according to Eurocode
* Collaborate with architects and other engineers to optimize building designs
* Ensure compliance with building codes and regulations
* Prepare detailed technical drawings and specifications
* Report and follow up on own progress and budget

### **Qualifications**


We expect that you have


* Master's degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering
* A minimum of 3 years of experience in structural design for buildings
* Proficiency in performing structural calculations both manually and using structural analysis software
* Proficiency in designing load\-bearing structures according to Eurocode
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills in English
* An unpretentious attitude, a team player, and a solution\-oriented mindset.

We appreciate if you also have


* Experience of working with projects in Sweden
* Proficiency in modelling and drawing production in Tekla or Revit
* Knowledge of Swedish

### **Company Description**


AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society.


AFRY employs over 18,000 professionals in more than 50 countries. Net sales in 2024 were SEK 27,160 million.


AFRY is organized into three Divisions: Energy; Industry and Transportation \& Places.


The Global Division Transportation \& Places is active within transportation infrastructure, real estate, water and environment in the Nordics and Central Europe. The division has about 6,500 employees and is structured around two segments: Road \& Rail and Public \& Commercial Places.


### **Additional Information**


To individuals who join our team, we offer:


* Employment based on an employment contract
* Private medical insurance, life assurance, sport card (Multisport) and a social found
* Exciting and challenging projects
* Personal development opportunities
* Friendly working atmosphere in a multidisciplinary and international team
* Helping to shape a sustainable future

We value a healthy work life balance and are committed to your wellbeing. We will operate a hybrid working environment.


*We are excited to receive your application,* ***please ensure your CV is in English****.*


Should you be successful you will be invited for a telephone interview followed by a 2 steps virtual or live face to face interview.


*At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.*



### **Apply information**

Structural Engineer for calculations (for projects in Sweden)
Location


Kraków
Country


Poland
Reference number

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Angular + .NET)
jobs.description:
**BlueSoft** to innowacyjny Software House należący do Grupy Orange. Mamy wewnętrzną filozofię – tworzenie prostych i skutecznych rozwiązań dla skomplikowanych problemów. Powstaliśmy w 2002 roku i obecnie pracuje z nami już ponad 1000 osób, które znają przeszło 200 technologii!

 **Opis projektu:**


Poszukujemy **Developera C\#/.NET z doświadczeniem w Angularze**, który dołączy do zespołu realizującego projekt dla sektora bankowego, w obszarze **rynków finansowych**.


Osoba na tym stanowisku będzie pracować przy rozwoju i utrzymaniu istniejących rozwiązań — zarówno **REST API**, jak i aplikacji frontendowej stworzonej w Angularze. Istotnym elementem pracy będzie również udział w procesie wdrażania modułów na platformę **OpenShift**.

 **Twoja rola w zespole:**

  

* rozwój i wsparcie istniejących modułów REST API,
* rozwój oraz utrzymanie aplikacji frontendowej w Angularze,
* implementacja nowych funkcjonalności i modyfikacja istniejących rozwiązań,
* współpraca z zespołem przy rozwoju aplikacji wykorzystywanych w obszarze rynków finansowych,
* udział we wdrażaniu modułów na platformę OpenShift,
* współpraca przy analizie i rozwiązywaniu problemów technicznych,
* dbanie o jakość i stabilność rozwijanych rozwiązań.
 **Poziom wiedzy i kwalifikacje:**

  

* zaawansowana znajomość C\# / .NET,
* zaawansowana znajomość Angulara,
* doświadczenie w pracy z REST API,
* podstawowa znajomość baz danych PostgreSQL,
* doświadczenie zawodowe na poziomie mid/senior (5–8 lat),
* umiejętność pracy w zespole i samodzielnego realizowania powierzonych zadań.

**Mile widziane:**

* doświadczenie z **OpenShift** lub innymi platformami konteneryzacyjnymi,
* doświadczenie w projektach dla sektora bankowego lub finansowego,
* znajomość specyfiki systemów związanych z rynkami finansowymi.
**Co zyskujesz dołączając do Bluesoft:**

* ‍ Współpracę w zespole interdyscyplinarnych ekspertów i ekspertek entuzjastycznie podchodzących do technologii, zainspirowanych pracą w płaskiej hierarchii;
* Stałą współpraca w pełnym wymiarze godzin w niezwykłej firmie, która rozwija się dynamicznie od 20 lat;
* Szansę na rozwój w różnorodnych projektach IT, realizowanych dla bardzo znanych i rozpoznawalnych klientów\- liderów w swoich branżach;
* Możliwość pracy z najnowszymi technologiami w oparciu o najwyższe standardy developmentu;
* + ️ Elastyczny czas i hybrydowy lub w pełni zdalny model pracy (w różnych zespołach funkcjonują różne ustalenia, nie narzucamy żadnych opcji);
	+ Szereg inicjatyw wspierających dzielenie się wiedzą i rozwój, takich jak: szkolenia wewnętrzne, gildie tematyczne, możliwość szkolenia i certyfikacji w zakresie Cloud (partnerstwa technologiczne w czterech chmurach);
* Możliwość nauki języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego online oraz zespołowe lekcje języka angielskiego;

️‍* ️ Możliwość dołączenia do Multisport i ubezpieczenia medycznego;
* + ️ Morskie przygody – z nami popływasz po Morzu Karaibskim, Śródziemnym lub Północnym (udział w rejsach firmowych jest dofinansowany przez firmę).
  

  

Proces rekrutacyjny składa się z 4 kroków :


1️⃣ Rozmowa telefoniczna


2️⃣ Spotkanie z managerem oraz ekspertem **(online)**


3️⃣ Merytoryczna informacja zwrotna


4️⃣ **Witamy na pokładzie** ‍ ‍ !

  

Na poszczególnych etapach rekrutacji oraz nawiązywania współpracy BlueSoft może wymagać weryfikacji tożsamości za pomocą kodu QR w aplikacji mObywatel.


Rekrutujemy zdalnie. Indywidualny onboarding całkowicie online !

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**Data powers every package we deliver—and as our Engineering Manager, you’ll power the team behind it.**


At Instabee, our Data Platform team is at the heart of how we make faster, smarter decisions, from lead times and locker performance to merchant checkout analytics. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, someone who's ready to grow people, scope projects and shape deliveries, and manage stakeholders with ease.


You should understand the product roadmap well enough to contribute to it, be comfortable facilitating discussions and unblocking the team, and bring enough high tech fluency to support the team when it's needed. You'll join our EM crew and work closely with your team's Product Manager, Staff Engineer, and business stakeholders across the company.

**Some of the things you'll do:**

* Lead a small, sharp team of engineers. 1:1s, coaching, hiring, and performance, all on you
* Continue build a team culture where psychological safety isn't a buzzword, it's the baseline
* Build a strong partnership with your Product Manager and Staff Engineer to clearly advocate for the team’s roadmap and constraints, while effectively bridging communication with Engineering Directors and Business Leads
* Help the team break down messy, ambiguous problems into concrete next steps
* Own delivery and team health in a lean setup. No safety net of extra support layers beneath you
* Help shape a strong EM culture by sharing what you learn (and stealing what works from others)

##### **Your future team**


The Data Platform team is a central team building a modern data platform on GCP and Snowflake for delivering core data products and metrics to the whole organization. It is pulling in data from everywhere, and owning everything from CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code to pipeline orchestration. The work is technical, high\-impact, and essential to whether the rest of the business can actually trust its data.

##### **What we're looking for**


We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys leading people and isn't afraid to dive into the messy parts of building a team.

**What you'll bring to the table:**

* **A coaching mindset and passion for team dynamics:** You are genuinely energized by growing people, building trust, and shaping high\-performing teams.
* **The courage to guide through change:** You have the guts to hold hard conversations when necessary and steer the team through organizational shifts.
* **Adaptive leadership:** The instinct to know when to lead versus when to manage, and the wisdom to tell the difference.
* **Scoping, prioritizing, and planning:** Proven ability to break apart complex projects into clear, actionable steps and realistic goals.
* **Ways of Working \& unblocking:** Expertise in agile practices, facilitating technical discussions, and clearing roadblocks to keep the team moving forward.
* **Clear stakeholder communication:** Strong expectation management skills across business leads and directors..
* **High\-level technical fluency:** Enough tech background (e.g., modern data platforms, infrastructure) to earn respect, understand context, and support the team where needed.
* **Product roadmap alignment:** Experience contributing directly to product strategy to advocate for the team’s roadmap.
* **Language skills:** Spoken or written Swedish is a plus, though English is our daily working language.

##### **What you'll get**


We can promise you'll be challenged, grow fast, and work alongside genuinely excellent people. If you like shaking things up and building new ways of working from scratch — this is your place.

**Beyond the usual essentials, we've also got:**


**Six months' parental pay:** Step away and give your little one everything they need


**A day off on your birthday:** Because you deserve to celebrate properly

**Hybrid \& Flexible:** Work the way that works for you


Diversity and inclusion matter deeply to us, and we're committed to building a workplace where every perspective is valued and everyone has room to grow.

**If leading through change, growing great engineers, and turning complex challenges into clear paths forward sounds like your kind of work, we’d love to hear from you!**

**Note on our process:** *As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy workplace, all candidates applying to Instabee in Sweden will undergo a background check conducted by Svensk Bakgrundsanalys. This review examines public criminal records and is a mandatory step in our recruitment process. While the results are public information, we handle all data with the utmost confidentiality.*
