jobs.title: Sr Software Dev Engineer III, RDS for Oracle
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services is hiring a Software Development Engineer III for the RDS for Oracle team. We are looking for an experienced engineer to design and build the next generation of managed database services that power mission\-critical applications worldwide.  

  

About the Role  

  

As a Software Development Engineer III on the RDS for Oracle team, you will own the design and implementation of complex features that scale to millions of database instances. You will work on the full stack—from kernel\-level optimizations and storage architecture to customer\-facing APIs and operational tooling. Your work directly impacts how enterprises run their most critical databases on AWS.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

You will lead the architecture and design of large\-scale, distributed database systems using RDS Oracle in AWS cloud environments. This includes optimizing performance for high\-availability and scalability, developing solutions that integrate Linux\-based RDS Oracle with AWS infrastructure, and designing integrations between Oracle and other AWS services such as EC2, VPC, and IAM.  

  

You will serve as a technical lead for enterprise\-level database services, addressing complex customer requirements and concerns. You will collaborate with account managers and solution architects to design and implement database solutions that meet specific enterprise needs. You will engage directly with customers to gather requirements, provide technical consultations, and support complex implementations, translating customer needs into technical specifications and product roadmap items.  

  

You will lead agile development cycles to quickly prototype, develop, and deploy new database features and improvements. You will balance speed of delivery with code quality, security, and scalability requirements. You will stay abreast of competitor offerings and contribute to product strategy by proposing and implementing innovative features to maintain AWS's competitive edge in the database services market.  

  

You will develop and implement strategies for managing database performance at massive scale, supporting thousands of concurrent customers. This includes creating advanced monitoring and troubleshooting tools for large\-scale database deployments and designing sophisticated automation systems for database management tasks. You will integrate AI and ML technologies to enhance database performance, security, and ease of use.  

  

You will ensure all database solutions meet required security standards and compliance regulations such as FedRAMP, GDPR, and HIPAA. You will develop and implement security best practices for database management in cloud environments.  

  

You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members, conduct design reviews, and offer feedback on architecture, performance, and scalability issues. You will create comprehensive technical documentation for internal teams and customers, including best practices guides, whitepapers, and other educational materials related to RDS Oracle on AWS.  

  

About the team  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  

  

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience in professional, non\-internship software development
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C\+\+, or C\# including object\-oriented design
* Experience in development in the last 3 years

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

You will join the team responsible for developing high\-performance video processing components used across several of Vizrt’s products, including our real\-time graphics, sports analysis, and media asset management solutions. As a senior engineer, you will work hands\-on with modern C\+\+ to develop and evolve these components. You will be part of a broader backend engineering environment responsible for several of Vizrt’s core technologies. Depending on product priorities and your interests, there may also be opportunities to contribute to other backend components, including the Vizrt Media Sequencer, a core platform used to control graphics, video, and other media in live production workflows.


We are looking for engineers who enjoy understanding complex systems, solving difficult technical problems, and building reliable software that operates in performance\-critical environments.


You will identify bottlenecks and bugs, design and implement new functionality, and help improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our software. You will work closely with experienced colleagues across multiple countries and teams, and your contributions will directly affect products used by broadcasters and content creators around the world.


For candidates interested in broader responsibility, there are opportunities to contribute to technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural decision\-making.

Vi søger en Senior Software Engineer, der mestrer sit håndværk, sætter en ære i clean code og robuste løsninger og har lyst til at tage et tydeligt teknisk ansvar i et af Nykredits mest forretningskritiske udviklingsteams.


Du bliver en central spiller i udviklingen af løsninger, der understøtter og håndterer centrale kundedata på tværs af hele koncernen. Det er software, der bliver brugt hver dag, og som skal fungere hver gang. Samtidig får du mulighed for at påvirke arkitektur, teknologivalg og udviklingsmetoder i tæt samarbejde med både forretningen og de teams, der er afhængige af jeres leverancer.


**Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver**  

Som Senior Software Engineer får du en rolle med både hands\-on udvikling og mulighed for teknisk lederskab:


* Udvikling af services og API’er: Design, udvikling og vedligeholdelse af højkvalitets software i Java afviklet på WebLogic og Kubernetes.
* Cloud platforme: Drive og understøtte ibrugtagning af cloud\-infrastruktur inden for kundedatadomænet.
* Kvalitet og standarder: Sikre høj kodekvalitet gennem bl.a. code reviews, ”Clean Code”\-principper og automatiserede tests som fx Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD), Test\-Driven Development (TDD).
* Performance og sikkerhed: Indtænke performance og sikkerhed i hele udviklingslivscyklussen – fra design til drift.
* Innovation og AI: Tage ejerskab for anvendelsen af AI\-værktøjer i udviklingsarbejdet og bidrage til smartere og mere effektive leverancer.
* Samarbejde på tværs: Arbejde tæt sammen med andre teams i Nykredit, hvor vores løsninger ofte er en kritisk byggesten i større initiativer.

**Er det dig, vi leder efter?**
  

Vi forestiller os, at du:


* Har minimum 5 års erfaring som softwareudvikler og er tryg i rollen som senior.
* Har en relevant uddannelse inden for datalogi, software engineering eller lignende – eller tilsvarende erfaring.
* Arbejder solidt med Java (Java EE / Jakarta EE / Spring Boot) og har erfaring med:
	+ API\-design og microservices
	+ CI/CD, event frameworks, datamodellering og databasemodellering
	+ Værktøjer som fx Atlassian tool suite, \-Maven, \-Github, \-SonarQube og \-Snyk m.fl.
* Anvender AI i dit daglige arbejde (i alle faser af udviklingsarbejdet)
* Har interesse for – og gerne erfaring med – finansielle systemer og komplekse forretningsdomæner.
* Tænker i løsninger, tager ansvar og trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og tæt samarbejde.
* Kommunikerer klart på dansk og engelsk og har lyst til at dele viden og løfte andre omkring dig.

Kendskab til Quarkus, .NET og Azure er en fordel, men ikke et krav.


Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.


**Dit nye team**
  

Du bliver en del af Core Customer\-teamet i Nykredit Core Banking, som har ansvaret for at levere IT\-løsninger inden for kunde\- og partsdata, herunder relaterede systemer, og som er i gang med en teknologisk transformation mod cloud\-baseret arkitektur.


Teamet er tværfagligt og består af udviklere, QA og forretningsprofiler fordelt mellem København og Warszawa, hvor samarbejde og fælles ejerskab for leverancerne er i fokus.


Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.


**Hvorfor skal du vælge os?**
  

I Nykredits IT\-afdeling bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor teknologi, samarbejde og kontinuerlig læring er centrale drivkræfter. Vi arbejder med komplekse og forretningskritiske løsninger, der har en konkret betydning for den finansielle sektor, og hvor kvalitet, stabilitet og sikkerhed ikke er til forhandling.


Du får mulighed for at arbejde på udfordrende projekter med reel forretningsmæssig værdi, i et miljø præget af faglig sparring, videndeling og fokus på arkitektur og bæredygtige løsninger. Stillingen er placeret på Nykredit\-koncernens hovedkontor i Nordhavn. Vi lægger vægt på fleksibilitet i hverdagen, så arbejdsliv og privatliv kan hænge fornuftigt sammen.


**Vil du vide mere?**
  

Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, Development Manager Jesper Søndergaard på tlf. 22 45 10 41, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Du kan også finde mig på LinkedIn her: Jesper Søndergaard \| LinkedIn

Du bliver en central brik på en række af vores vigtigste projekter og i vores organisation, hvor du med din erfaring og kompetencer er med til at styrke vores leverancer. Området vi søger indenfor driver nogle af vores største web\-applikationer.


Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med andre dygtige og ambitiøse udviklere. Derudover indgår projektledere, rådgivere, designere og UX\-specialister på vores teams.

### **Hvad leder vi efter?**

* Ca. 5 års fuldtidserfaring inden for softwareudvikling og har opnået en solid forståelse for hele softwareudviklingsprocessen – fra arkitektur og specifikation til udvikling og vedligeholdelse.
* Erfaring med C\#/.NET/Azure økosystemet og glad for postgress.
* Erfaring med web\-applikationer og uforskrækket over at lave mindre React\-opgaver, selvom det ikke er din primære kompetence.
* Nysgerrig over for AI og så meget hands\-on erfaring at du ved, hvad der (ofte) virker. Bruger Claude Code eller Codex eller Pi.dev eller OpenCode eller tilsvarende. Du behøver ikke være totalt AI\-pilled.
* Gode mundtlige og skriftlige kommunikationsevner og kan formidle komplekse tekniske problemstillinger på en forståelig måde til både tekniske og ikke\-tekniske interessenter på dansk.
* Er selvstændig, struktureret og \- meget vigtigt \- nysgerrig på, hvad der sker inden for de nyeste teknologier inden for webudvikling.
* Du synes, at det er sjovt at løse problemer med teknologi generelt \- ikke kun når du får penge for det.
* Hvis du har erfaring fra bureau eller konsulentvirksomhed er det en fordel.
* Et særligt plus, hvis du har erfaring eller domæneviden fra offentlige kunder og sagsbehandlingssystemer.

**Hvad kan du forvente i Eksponent?**
-------------------------------------

* Dygtige kolleger og ambitiøse kunder
* Et fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til hjemmearbejde
* Effektive projektforløb, hvor du løbende ser resultatet af dit arbejde
* Et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi arbejder tværfagligt og passer på hinanden
* En faglig konto til kurser og læring
* En hardwarekonto og eget valg af computer og telefon
* God kantineordning og masser af sociale events
* Konkurrencedygtig løn med pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring, telefon og internet

### **Hvem er vi?**


I Eksponent arbejder vi med digitalisering. Vores mål er at hjælpe kunder med at forbedre kommunikation, samarbejde og services. Vi designer og udvikler ambitiøse digitale produkter \- fra websites til forretningssystemer. Vi rådgiver, faciliterer, og inddrager brugere og kunder. Kulturen er uformel, men professionel. Nysgerrighed, faglighed og fællesskab går hånd i hånd.


Samarbejdet med vores kunder er baseret på et partnerskabs\-mindset, hvor vi gør meget ud af at forstå vores kunders forretning og organisation. Det gør os i stand til at styre og rådgive bedre, og det er forudsætningen for den særlige kundekultur, som Eksponent er kendt for.

### **Vil du vide mere?**


Vil du vide mere om stillingen, og hvordan vi arbejder med softwareudvikling i Eksponent, er du velkommen til at kontakte Martin (martin.bjorn@eksponent.com) eller Christian (christian.dalager@eksponent.com).

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@eksponent.com og skriv “Fullstack udvikler .Net / AI” i emnefeltet. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: .NET-udvikler til Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Vi søger en backend\-udvikler til Product Engineering, der har lyst til at være med fra bunden – og som samtidig kan bygge løsninger, der holder, når belastningen topper.


Du bliver en del af et team, hvor app og backend arbejder som ét hold. Her er der kort fra idé til kode, og du får mandat til at træffe de arkitekturvalg, der skal bære os de næste mange år.

**Om jobbet**


Som .NET\-udvikler sidder du tæt på både app\-udviklerne, produktet og forretningen. Du kommer blandt andet til at:

* Designe og udvikle skalerbare, sikre og hurtige API’er i C\# og moderne .NET
* Bygge det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser
* Sikre fremdrift i app\-teamet med mock\-API’er og prototyper, mens den robuste løsning modnes
* Bruge moderne AI\-kodeværktøjer til at effektivisere boilerplate, test og optimering
* Sikre driftssikkerhed og performance i løsninger, der skal klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger

**Om dig**


Vi forestiller os, at du genkender dig selv i flere af nedenstående punkter:

* **Dyb .NET\-ekspertise:** Du er en stærk håndværker i C\# og moderne .NET, og du forstår at bygge skalerbare, sikre og lynhurtige API’er.
* **Frontend\-empati:** Du forstår, at dit API er fundamentet for app\-oplevelsen. Du tænker over latency og smarte payloads og bygger API’er, der gør livet let og hurtigt for den iOS\-udvikler, der skal konsumere dem.
* **Pragmatisk fremdrift:** Du kender vigtigheden af at sikre fremdrift for dine aftagere. Du leverer hurtigt mock\-API’er og prototyper, der sikrer fremdrift, mens du bygger den langsigtede og robuste arkitektur under kølerhjelmen.
* **Agentic AI\-kompetence:** Du har praktisk erfaring med – eller stor nysgerrighed for – at udnytte agentic workflows, prompt engineering og AI\-værktøjer til at accelerere din kode\- og udviklingsproces.
* **Product Engineer\-mindset:** Du tænker som en Product Engineer. Du koder ikke bare kravspecifikationer, men engagerer dig i brugerrejsen og forretningsværdien.

**Om Product Engineering**


Product Engineering er produktfokuseret, eksekverende, samarbejdsorienteret, autonom og ambitiøs. Vi bygger for brugeren frem for systemets skyld, vi arbejder som ét team på tværs af app og backend, og vi har mandatet til selv at træffe de rigtige arkitekturvalg. Ambitionen er driftssikre løsninger, der kan håndtere massiv skala.

**Hvorfor Danske Spil?**


Hos Danske Spil får du en ret unik mulighed: startup\-viben ved at være med til at bygge et nyt, stærkt in\-house app\-udviklingsmiljø op fra bunden – men med skalaen, tyngden og volumen fra en af Danmarks største digitale forretninger.


Som backend\-udvikler i Product Engineering bliver du ikke gemt væk i en silo. Du sidder helt tæt på app\-udviklerne og forretningen og får direkte indflydelse på det arkitektoniske fundament, der skal drive fremtidens spiloplevelser. Du arbejder agilt og autonomt med moderne, AI\-støttede værktøjer. Det er den perfekte legeplads, hvis du motiveres af at bygge API’er, der både kræver høj fart og innovation i hverdagen, og som samtidig skal kunne klare ekstreme spidsbelastninger uden at blinke.

**Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?**


Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 9\. oktober 2026\. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Persson på jepe@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

jobs.title: RVP, Solutions Engineering APAC
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Location:Singapore**

**Reports To: SVP, Global Presales**

Zendesk is looking for a visionary, highly technical, and dynamic **Regional Vice President of Sales Engineering** to lead, scale, and inspire our world\-class team of Sales Engineers. Zendesk has evolved far beyond traditional ITSM and help desk ticketing; we are the world’s leading **AI\-powered Customer Experience (CX) platform** .


In this role, you will bridge the gap between cutting\-edge AI capabilities and enterprise business value. As a key partner to regional sales leadership, you will drive our expansion into net\-new enterprise markets, optimize technical win rates, and ensure our customers accelerate their time\-to\-value. You must be a technical heavyweight, an inspiring leader of leaders, and a compelling public speaker capable of evangelizing the future of AI\-driven CX to C\-suite executives.


### **What You’ll Be Doing:**

* **Strategic Market Expansion:** Partner with Regional RVPs of Sales to penetrate new enterprise markets and verticals. Architect the pre\-sales blueprint required to land complex, large\-scale enterprise accounts.
* **Drive Technical Win \& Adoption Rates:** Establish rigorous pre\-sales frameworks, proof\-of\-concept (PoC) and pilot standards, and custom demo strategies that directly improve technical win rates and lay the foundation for rapid post\-sale user adoption.
* **Team Development \& Leadership:** Attract, hire, and retain top\-tier pre\-sales talent. Cultivate a high\-performance culture focused on technical excellence and consultative value selling. Mentor front\-line SE managers to become impactful leaders.
* **AI \& CX Thought Leadership:** Serve as a primary technical evangelist for the region. Deliver compelling keynotes at industry events, lead executive briefings, and command authority during large\-scale enterprise pitches by articulating Zendesk’s advanced AI and platform capabilities.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Act as a critical feedback loop between the field, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure our AI CX roadmap continues to solve the most pressing challenges of the world's largest enterprises.

### **Qualifications \& Requirements**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent technical field is **required** . An advanced degree or MBA is a plus.
* **Management Experience:** 8\+ years of experience managing pre\-sales/sales engineering teams, with at least 3\+ years of experience managing people\-managers (leading a multi\-tiered organization) within a fast\-growing, enterprise SaaS environment.
* **CX Domain Expertise:** Deep familiarity with the broader **Customer Experience (CX) ecosystem** , including CRM, contact center technology (CCaaS), workforce engagement management (WEM), and digital engagement channels.
* **Advanced Technical Acumen:** Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS), data privacy/security compliance, complex integrations (REST APIs, webhooks), and a strong foundational grasp of **Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and machine learning applications** in CX.

At Zendesk, we are entirely focused on liberating companies from legacy, fragmented systems by providing an intelligent, unified AI CX platform. Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.


As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.

jobs.title: Green Building & Energy Engineer
jobs.description:
The Green Building \& Energy /Solar Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing solar energy systems and other renewable energy solutions. This role involves conducting technical assessments, preparing feasibility studies, managing installation projects, and ensuring compliance with sustainability standards and regulations. The engineer will also provide expertise on energy efficiency initiatives, performance monitoring, and cost optimization.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**System Design \& Engineering:** Design solar PV systems (rooftop, ground\-mounted, hybrid, off\-grid, on\-grid) including electrical, structural, and mechanical components. Perform energy yield simulations and financial analysis using tools such as PVsyst, Helioscope, or HOMER. Develop system layouts, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings.
  
  

**Feasibility \& Site Assessment:** Conduct site visits, shading analysis, and structural evaluations. Assess solar potential, energy consumption patterns, and load profiles. Prepare feasibility reports and ROI projections.
  
  

**Project Execution \& Management:** Support procurement of solar modules, inverters, batteries, and balance\-of\-system equipment. Coordinate with EPC contractors, vendors, and stakeholders during installation. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with safety standards.
  
  

**Operations \& Maintenance:** Monitor system performance and troubleshoot technical issues. Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance for solar systems. Recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and reliability.
  
  

**Energy Efficiency \& Sustainability:** Identify and implement energy\-saving measures across facilities. Support net\-zero, carbon reduction, and ESG initiatives. Provide technical input for sustainability reporting and certification programs.
  
  

Job Requirements
  
  

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  
  

2\-5 years of experience in solar PV design, installation, or energy engineering.
  
  

Proficiency with solar design software (PVsyst, AutoCAD, Helioscope, HOMER, etc.).
  
  

Strong knowledge of electrical codes, grid connection requirements, and safety standards.
  
  

Familiarity with energy storage, hybrid systems, and smart grid technologies is a plus.
  
  

Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and project management skills.
  
  

Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  
  

Experience with utility\-scale solar projects or microgrids.
  
  

Knowledge of green building standards (LEED, BREEAM, Green Mark).
  
  

Familiarity with AI/IoT solutions for energy monitoring and predictive maintenance.

jobs.title: AI Reimagination Engineer
jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**


Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


As an AI Reimagination Engineer in Micron's Generative AI Center of Excellence (GenAI COE), you have an outstanding chance to transform how businesses function. You will partner with different business areas to break down large, manual, multi\-step processes and redesign them into effective, autonomous systems. This position combines process reimagination with AI systems engineering, making you a key part of the transformation journey. You will collaborate closely with the GenAI COE, IT architecture, security, and project teams. You will lead projects from the initial redesign to the final build, delivering solutions that business teams can adopt and scale.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Decompose end\-to\-end processes: Map current\-state flows, quantify effort and risk, and lead eliminate/simplify/agentify analysis before automation.
* Architect the agentic solution: Build future\-state flows and AI architecture, including task and agent decomposition, orchestration patterns, tool and data access, memory and context strategy, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Translate inventions into buildable solutions by developing agent workflows, composing prompt and context strategies, MCP/connector and integration requirements, and evaluation criteria. Follow Micron's “Secure by Design” and data\-classification standards.
* Prototype and build: Construct working agentic solutions, or direct their build with platform engineers, validating fit and value prior to full delivery.
* Engineer trust and control: Define testable human\-in\-the\-loop controls and least\-privilege permissions for each process step.
* Drive multi\-functional delivery: Collaborate across the client function, IT architecture, security, platform engineers, and the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) through first production release.
* Measure value and codify patterns: Capture value baselines during discovery, support 30/90\-day post\-release measurement, and turn findings into reference flows, decomposition patterns, and playbooks. Mentor engineers and grow the network of agentic champions.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, AI/ML, engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience blending technical delivery with business process work.
* Hybrid Experience: Proven track record in both decomposing complex business processes and crafting or building technical solutions.
* Agentic Delivery: 8\+ years of overall experience and 3\+ years in AI/ML. Recently, hands\-on experience building agentic or LLM\-based systems.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Process Redesign: Experience leading workshop\-based process redesign and translating findings into requirements. Familiar with AI governance, responsible\-AI, security fundamentals, and validation/testing strategies for autonomous behavior.
* Technical Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with enterprise AI and automation platforms, and proficiency across Python, .NET/C\#, SQL, and APIs. Depth in agent orchestration and multi\-agent development, context management, and long\-horizon tasks.
* Communication: Excellent facilitation, written, and executive interpersonal skills. Proficient in running discovery with business leaders and driving alignment across business, engineering, and risk teams.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**


We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high\-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.  

  

To learn more, please visit micron.com/careers  

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.  

  

To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_sg@micron.com


Micron Prohibits the use of child labor and complies with all applicable laws, rules, regulations, and other international and industry labor standards.


Micron does not charge candidates any recruitment fees or unlawfully collect any other payment from candidates as consideration for their employment with Micron.


AI alert: Candidates are encouraged to use AI tools to enhance their resume and/or application materials. However, all information provided must be accurate and reflect the candidate's true skills and experiences. Misuse of AI to fabricate or misrepresent qualifications will result in immediate disqualification.


Fraud alert: Micron advises job seekers to be cautious of unsolicited job offers and to verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Micron by checking the official Micron careers website in the About Micron Technology, Inc.

jobs.title: Ai First Software Engineer ( Net & Go)
jobs.description:
Hledáme vývojáře, který už změnil způsob, jakým píše software. Ne někoho, kdo si občas nechá doplnit funkci od Copilota — ale člověka, který umí zadání rozložit do specifikace, pustit na ni agenta, výsledek zkritizovat a dotáhnout do produkce. AI nástroje u nás nejsou experiment, jsou součástí denní pipeline.


### **Co tě čeká**

* Vývoj backendových služeb v **.NET** nebo **Go** v microservices architektuře.
* Práce ve **spec\-first režimu**: zadání analýza/PRD implementace PR review loop merge, s agenty (Claude Code) jako běžnou součástí procesu.
* Psaní kontextu pro agenty: instrukce k repozitářům, guardraily, evaluace výstupů.
* **Review agentních PR** — zodpovědnost za kód a jeho chování v produkci zůstává na člověku.
* Zlepšování vývojářské pipeline pro celý tým a sdílení toho, co funguje, na interním AI Weekly.
* DevOps kultura: nasazujeme v **AWS**, monitorujeme přes **Datadog a Prometheus**, používáme **feature flags** a **CI/CD**.

### **Koho hledáme**

* Máš několik let solidní zkušenosti s backendovým vývojem (**.NET Core** nebo **Go**; jiný silný jazyk s ochotou přejít je taky varianta).
* **AI nástroje používáš denně** a umíš věcně říct, kde ti pomáhají a kde ti lžou.
* Umíš napsat specifikaci, kterou zvládne odbavit agent — a zároveň poznáš, kdy je rychlejší to napsat rovnou sám.
* Zdravá skepse: testy, review, observabilita. Vygenerovanému kódu nevěříš víc než vlastnímu.
* Zajímá tě, jak se aplikace chovají v produkci, a DevOps přístup bereš jako samozřejmost.
* Máš češtinu na úrovni rodilého mluvčího (nebo se tomu aspoň blížíš) a angličtina ti také problém nedělá


**Výhodou:** MCP servery, RAG, práce s embeddingy a vyhledáváním, evaluace a měření kvality LLM výstupů, spec\-driven nástroje (OpenSpec, Spec Kit), zkušenost s češtinou jako jazykem modelu.


### **Co nabízíme**

* Firemní **předplatné Claude** a plnou podporu v používání AI nástrojů — máme vlastní interní guidelines i pravidelné sdílení.
* Prostor **spoluurčovat, jak celá firma vyvíjí software** — ne jen dodávat tasky.
* Práci v týmu, který spojuje vývoj, provoz i produktové myšlení.
* **Hybridní režim** (on\-site v Praze, kombinace remote podle dohody).
* **Přátelskou kulturu**, kde vítáme nové nápady a otevřenou komunikaci.
* **25 dní dovolené \+ 2 dny volna navíc** – ať si opravdu odpočineš.
* **Třikrát v týdnu jídlo v kanclu zadarmo** – v úterý ovoce, ve středu snídaně a ve čtvrtek sladká tečka.
* **Dovoz obědů až do kanclu** za zvýhodněnou cenu.
* **Stravenkový paušál za každý odpracovaný den.**
* **Mobilní tarif od T\-Mobile zadarmo** – neomezené volání, SMS a internet do 8 GB, s možností rozšíření i pro blízké.
* **MultiSport karta.**
* **Pravidelné firemní akce.**
* **Slevy na masáže.**
* **Slevy na naše produkty** – auto si jako náš zaměstnanec pojistíš se slevou 45 %, cestovní pojištění pro sebe i své blízké se slevou 70 %.

jobs.title: API Engineer — DEK, a.s.
jobs.description:
**Dynamicky se rozvíjející společnost DEK a.s. hledá do svého týmu kolegu/kolegyni na pozici:**
**API Engineer — DEK, a.s.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


MÁM ZÁJEM O POZICI
V DEK vyvíjíme vlastní informační systém na míru našim procesům a provozujeme desítky interních služeb. Data a funkce z těchto systémů dnes potřebují nejen naše aplikace, ale i integrace s partnery a nově vznikající AI řešení. Do týmu hledáme kolegu/kolegyni na pozici API Engineer, který/á bude rozhodovat o podobě našich API, od návrhu kontraktu přes zabezpečení, oprávnění a dokumentaci až po provoz, monitoring a řešení incidentů. Bude nastavovat pravidla, jak mají firemní API vypadat, aby se k datům přistupovalo jednotně, bezpečně a udržitelně.


**Pracovní náplň**
* Návrh API kontraktů – endpointy, datové struktury, chybové stavy
* Spolupráce s vývojáři a vlastníky procesů při určování, jaká data a funkce mají být přes API dostupné
* Řízení oprávnění k jednotlivým API a datům
* Verzování API a řízení zpětné kompatibility
* Dokumentace API pomocí OpenAPI / Swagger
* Monitoring dostupnosti, výkonu a chybovosti API, logování a audit přístupů
* Řešení incidentů v produkčním provozu
* Návrh standardů a pravidel pro API napříč firmou (API governance)
* Spolupráce s Platform/DevOps týmem na nasazování a provozu
* Podpora vývojářů a dalších konzumentů API

**Požadujeme*** Praktickou zkušenost s návrhem a architekturou REST API
* Základní znalost některého programovacího jazyka (.NET, Python, Java, Node.js apod.), znalost SQL
* Zkušenost s OpenAPI / Swagger a s tvorbou srozumitelné dokumentace
* Znalost Gitu a běžné práce s verzováním
* Schopnost navrhovat standardy a prosazovat je napříč týmy
* Samostatnost, iniciativu a chuť domlouvat se s vývojáři, vlastníky procesů i zadavateli
* Český jazyk na úrovni C1
* VÝHODOU:
* Zkušenost s provozem služeb na IIS a v prostředí Microsoft/Windows Server
* Regresní a výkonnostní testování (Postman, k6 apod.)
* Monitoring a logování (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK nebo obdobné)
* Zkušenost s návrhem datových modelů, UML nebo BPMN

**Nabízíme**
* Flexibilní nastavení pracovní doby dle individuální potřeby
* 5 týdnů dovolené a 2 sick days
* Školení, e\-learningové programy a jazykové kurzy
* Občerstvení na pracovišti
* Zvýhodněné mobilní tarify
* Služební notebook a telefon
* MultiSport kartu, příspěvek na penzijní pojištění a další
* Slevy u obchodních partnerů, účast na teambuildingových aktivitách a další zážitky
* Nástupní mzda 65 000 až 80 000 Kč dle zkušeností

**Pracoviště**
* Praha 10 – Malešice

V případě zájmu zašlete prosím svůj strukturovaný životopis na adresu přes odpovědní formulář na stránkách www.dek.cz.

jobs.title: Principal Engineering Manager (Microsoft Security)
jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Security is one of the most critical priorities for customers navigating digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and growing estate complexity. Microsoft Security brings together identity, access, data, cloud, and threat protection to help make the digital world safer. The Microsoft Entra Application Governance team builds core capabilities that help enterprises discover, manage, govern, and secure application identities at scale. As organizations adopt AI\-powered applications, agents, automation, and other non\-human identities, our mission is expanding to provide the visibility, least\-privilege controls, lifecycle management, and policy enforcement needed to adopt this new generation of software securely. We are looking for a Principal Engineering Manager to lead a team working at the intersection of identity, security, AI, governance, and cloud\-scale distributed systems. You will set technical and execution direction, build a strong engineering culture, and partner across Microsoft to deliver platform capabilities that directly affect customer security, compliance, and operational efficiency. This role combines people leadership, deep engineering judgment, product thinking, and accountability for reliable services operating at global scale. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. jobs.title: Web Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Engineering @ XE**


Helping our customers find what they are looking for easily, quickly and unambiguously is the sole most important factor that influences what we do in Engineering at xe.gr. Our engineers focus on developing high traffic and always\-on web applications specialized in classifieds, optimizing our systems for performance and resilience and delivering features that make the journey of our customers easier. All of our systems are running in the AWS cloud and we make extensive use of AWS services.


Joining our engineering team means you'll be actively shaping the company's future by driving innovation with state\-of\-the\-art technologies.

 **About the job opportunity**


You will be a part of our Web Team and use your experience to inform our engineering process when building new features or enhancing existing ones.


This is a technical role, but frequent liaison with the Product and Design team is essential.

 **What Will I Be Doing?**


As a Web Software Engineer you will:

* Participate in the design, development, and testing of existing and new software applications.
* Work in collaboration with our product owners, designers and other developers (backend and frontend) in order to translate the company’s and customers’ needs into state\-of\-the\-art, functional, and beautiful interactive applications.
* Release frequently to production. We strive for small, frequent, and incremental releases that continuously provide value.
* Write clean, testable, and maintainable code.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and debug defects in application code.

**Our web stack:**

* Our stack consists of React with Ruby on Rails acting as our backend.
* We are not using a database\-powered backend, but a distributed system solution.
* Our setup is fully deployed on the cloud.

**What skills do I need?**

* Minimum 3 years experience in a Software Development position, and a proven track record of high traffic production projects.
* Hands\-on experience (at least 2 years) with a modern javascript framework. React is the preferred javascript framework, but Angular, vue or nextJS are also fine.
* Hands\-on experience with backend solutions of any stack. Ruby on Rails is preferred but nodeJs, .Net or Java are fine as well.
* The ideal candidate should also have experience with consuming RESTful backend services.
* Good understanding of web architecture is a must.
* Solid engineering principles. You know how to write clean, idiomatic code and you are aware of the trade\-offs involved when making design decisions.
* Some previous experience with working with distributed systems is required. Public cloud experience is considered a plus.
* Experience with any of the following testing tools (jest, react\-testing\-library and rspec) is considered a plus.
* Experience with a version control system (preferably Git).
* Strong communication skills. Code reviews are part of our daily lives, so you should be able to clearly explain complex technical issues to all level team members, while reviewing code or through Jira issues.
* Greek candidates need to have fulfilled military obligations and the ability to communicate in Greek and English (verbal \& written form, business proficiency).

**Where will I be working?**


Our current policy over office attendance is that of a hybrid model allowing our engineers to work remotely while meeting up a few times per week at the office.


Engineers that are based outside Athens are considered fully remote employees while always being welcome to join us at the office for a team event!

**What happens when I apply?**


The first step in our hiring process is to review your CV. If you seem to be qualified for this position, we will be having a quick phone call with you to welcome you to the process and we will give you a take home code challenge to work on your own time. Once we receive your response to the challenge, the next step is its evaluation from our Engineering managers. Depending on the challenge review, our HR team will inform you for the last recruiting stage which is an interview (virtual or physical) with the recruiting team (HR and Engineers).


The interview time is focused on cultural fit and technical discussion mainly on the code challenge you have sent.

**We offer**

* Group Health Insurance program.
* Competitive salary dependent on the candidate's skills and performance.
* A great opportunity to grow and work closely with a talented team **with around 60 engineers**, in a modern, human\-centric and friendly working environment.
* Remote work options.
* High tech IT equipment.

**Diversity statement**


At xe.gr we support human rights and focus on creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All candidates are treated equally, regardless of race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion.

jobs.title: Stage / TFE – Développeur C#
jobs.description:
**DevTeix** est une société dynamique d'une dizaine de personnes qui développe, depuis plus de 30 ans, des logiciels sur mesure pour l'industrie. Elle commercialise notamment des logiciels de gestion de production (GPAO) destinés aux usines de charpentes métalliques et de bois lamellé\-collé : Steel Manager et Wood Manager. Les bureaux de DevTeix sont situés dans le zoning industriel des Hauts\-Sarts, à Herstal.

**Wood Manager**, l'application la plus récente de DevTeix, est développée entièrement en C\# et utilisée quotidiennement en atelier pour piloter la production de poutres en bois lamellé\-collé, depuis la réception des pièces jusqu'à leur mise en presse pour le collage. Une étape centrale de cette production est le plan de serrage : une fenêtre dans laquelle l'opérateur dispose, oriente et ajuste les poutres qui seront collées ensemble, via une visionneuse 3D (Eyeshot).

Cette fenêtre propose de nombreuses actions qui, une fois effectuées, sont directement enregistrées en base de données. Le revers de cet enregistrement immédiat : il n'existe aujourd'hui aucun moyen de revenir en arrière, et la moindre erreur de manipulation oblige l'opérateur à corriger la situation manuellement.

Votre mission sera de développer un véritable système d'annulation et de rétablissement (Ctrl\+Z / Ctrl\+Y) pour cette fenêtre. Cela demande de bien comprendre le fonctionnement actuel du plan de serrage et l'ensemble de ses actions, puis de concevoir une structure (par exemple basée sur le patron de conception Command) capable, pour chaque type d'action, de mémoriser les informations nécessaires pour la rejouer ou l'inverser, et d'intégrer cette structure aux traitements existants. Certains cas demanderont une attention particulière, comme les opérations qui génèrent de nouvelles poutres en base (délignage, reprise, aboutage), à annuler proprement sans laisser de données orphelines. Vous réfléchirez aussi à la présentation de cette fonctionnalité à l'utilisateur : raccourcis clavier, boutons, retours visuels clairs.

**Stack technique :** C\#, DevExpress, Eyeshot, SQL Server, EF Core. Aucune connaissance préalable de ces outils n'est requise. La connaissance d'un langage orienté objet (C\#, Java, C\+\+...) ainsi que quelques notions de bases de données sont un plus.

Le stage se déroule en partie sur site à Herstal et en partie à distance (une connexion internet à domicile est nécessaire). Matériel et licences sont fournis par DevTeix. Durée minimale de 3 mois, prolongeable à la demande de l'étudiant, avec un début flexible. Vous serez encadré par un responsable de projet et un développeur DevTeix, et un référent académique est le bienvenu.

Pour candidater, contactez José Teixeira, Executive Director, par mail à j.teixeira@vvtw.be ou par téléphone au \+32 487 41 91 20\.

Avantages :

* Ordinateur de fonction
* Travail à domicile

Lieu du poste : En présentiel

Als führende Schweizer E\-Commerce\-Plattform, mit einem Team von über 4’000 Mitarbeitenden in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Serbien, sind wir auf dem Weg in neue Märkte. Unser Motor dafür ist der Wille, Bestehendes immer wieder neu zu denken. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die mit Leidenschaft daran arbeiten, Dinge wirklich besser zu machen. Bei uns findest du die Freiheit und das Vertrauen, eigenverantwortlich zu handeln, mit uns zu wachsen und dabei ganz du selbst zu sein. **Handle galaktisch. Und bleib du.**


Magazinartikel auf unserer Startseite sind unser Markenzeichen. Unsere Redaktion erstellt Artikel und Videos, die personalisiert und kombiniert mit weiteren Inhalten auf der Startseite, auf Unterseiten und im Newsletter ausgespielt werden. Das Team «Clippy» trägt die volle Produktverantwortung für die dafür eingesetzten Lösungen und arbeitet eng mit der Redaktion zusammen. Du führst dieses crossfunktionale Team, das sich mit Frontend\-, Backend\- und Machine\-Learning\-Themen beschäftigt, um unsere Kundinnen und Kunden mit passenden Inhalten zu begeistern.


Dafür suchen wir eine verantwortungsbewusste Person mit viel Drive, technischer Neugier, Empathie und starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – jemanden, der ein neues Team formen, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit motivierten Engineers eine klare Produktvision in wirksame Lösungen übersetzen möchte.



### **Your responsibilities**


* Mit der Führung des Teams übernimmst du die Verantwortung für eine erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit sowie die Weiterentwicklung der Produkte
* Einen wesentlichen Teil deiner Zeit arbeitest du hands\-on mit, entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team skalierbare Features und wirkst bei architektonischen Entscheidungen mit. Dabei sorgst du für eine gemeinsame technische und fachliche Ausrichtung im Team
* Gemeinsam mit deinem Team setzt du Verhaltensdaten und Machine\-Learning\-Modelle sinnvoll ein. Damit entwickelt ihr Lösungen, die über klassische regelbasierte Ansätze hinausgehen und eine weitgehend automatisierte, personalisierte Ausspielung von Inhalten ermöglichen
* Als Sparringpartner für Product Owner, UX Designer, Data Analysts, Data Scientists und Software\-Architekten erklärst du technische Themen so, dass sie auch ausserhalb des Engineerings verständlich sind
* Themen treibst du im Team und darüber hinaus voran, hältst Stakeholder auf dem Laufenden und machst die Erfolge deines Teams sichtbar. Als Bindeglied zum Head of Engineering trägst du Entscheidungen zurück ins Team
* Die fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung deiner Teammitglieder liegt in deiner Verantwortung
* Als verlässliche Führungskraft befähigst du dein Team, selbst Entscheidungen zu treffen, nimmst seine Anliegen ernst und schaffst ein motivierendes und positives Umfeld
### **Your skills**


* Führungserfahrung und Freude am Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten und kulturellen Hintergründen zeichnen dich aus
* Deine Erfahrung im Software Engineering oder in Data Science hilft dir, dich sicher zwischen beiden Disziplinen zu bewegen und sie miteinander zu verbinden. Idealerweise kennst du C\#/.NET, verteilte Systeme und moderne Webtechnologien und bringst auch Kenntnisse in Machine\-Learning\-Modellen, Python oder DAGs mit
* KI\-gestützte Entwicklung mit Claude Code, Agents und Skills gehört zu deinem Arbeitsalltag – von der Analyse über die Implementierung bis zum Testing. Dabei setzt du diese Tools reflektiert und verantwortungsvoll ein und prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch
* Agile Prinzipien, Guidelines und Formalitäten sind dir vertraut. Du wendest sie pragmatisch und mit Augenmass an
* Dein Interesse gilt dem Produkt und seiner Weiterentwicklung. Du orientierst dich an der Wirkung eurer Arbeit und hinterfragst den konkreten Nutzen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden
* Positive Ausstrahlung, natürliche Motivationsfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, Teams zu inspirieren sowie ein Umfeld psychologischer Sicherheit zu schaffen
* Fliessende Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
* Die Bereitschaft, „wie es immer gemacht wurde“ in Frage zu stellen und effizientere, automatisierte oder effektivere Lösungen vorzuschlagen
* Den Mut haben, Dinge auszuprobieren, ohne sie bis ins kleinste Detail zu planen
### **Why start with us?**


* **Werte statt Blabla**: Kooperativ, innovativ, piratisch, eigenverantwortlich, ambitioniert – diese fünf Werte fordern wir alle und leben wir alle.
* **Mutig selbst denken**: Wir ermutigen alle, selbst und aktiv mitzudenken. Und lieben es, wenn du noch dazu mutig, neu und anders denkst.
* **Unkompliziert**: Wir vermeiden Unnötiges und fokussieren uns aufs Wichtige. Vom Meistern von Herausforderungen bis zum Feiern unserer Erfolge.
* **Flexibilität statt verbiegen**: Neben Homeoffice Möglichkeiten ermöglichen wir dir bis zu 8 Wochen Workation. Zudem ist jede Position auch im 80%\-Pensum möglich.
* **Schnelles Wachstum**: Bei uns wächst und entwickelst du dich laufend. Und erhältst 2'000 EDU\-Punkte pro Jahr für deine Weiterentwicklung, damit du nicht stehenbleibst.
* **Modern:** Bei uns kannst du täglich mit neusten Technologien arbeiten, siehe unser Tech\-Radar.
* **Mehr als "nur" Arbeit:** Nimm an unseren diversen Mitarbeiterevents wie Hackathons, Wandern, Ski fahren, Böötlen auf der Limmat, Lan Parties oder Friday Night Drinks teil und bring dich bei Interesse in unserem Techblog ein.
* **Weitere Benefits**: Profitiere von 25 Tagen Ferien, exklusiven Mitarbeiterpreisen im Shop, Handy\-, Internet\- und TV\-Abos zum Firmentarif und weiteren Vorteilen.

**Diversität ist unsere Kultur.**


Um das beste Team zu bilden, sind wir offen für Menschen jedes Hintergrunds. Das heisst: Bei uns haben alle die gleichen Chancen. Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, geschlechtliche Identität, sexuelle Orientierung und Alter spielen dabei keine Rolle. Denn Inklusion bedeutet für uns, dass jede\*r willkommen und jeder Beitrag wertvoll ist.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

As part of the Technical Coordination team for the CMS Experiment at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC), you will join the Safety Team and familiarise yourself with CERN and CMS safety systems and alarms, hazard identification and risk assessment processes, as well as CMS infrastructure and computing tools.

**Your responsibilities**

* Support the CMS LEXGLIMOS (Large Experiment Group Leader in Matters of Safety), working closely with the CMS Technical Coordination team and contributing to implementing CERN's safety objectives within CMS and defining the associated priorities and timelines.
* Contribute to drafting and reviewing risk assessments and procedures for projects, works, areas and activities, and to updating the associated Safety File, particularly in support of the LS3 CMS upgrade.
* Help manage and assess the fire safety compliance of materials used in the CMS Phase II Upgrade Projects, including follow\-up risk assessments for potentially non\-compliant materials.
* Perform incident analyses and follow up on the implementation of safety actions and safety measures to support continuous improvement.
* Support emergency preparedness activities within CMS, including the coordination and organisation of planned evacuations.

**Your profile**

* Basic experience in engineering (safety, industrial, mechanical, or a related field).
* Exposure to laboratory, workshop, or technical environments.
* Initial experience (through academic projects, internships, or similar activities) in risk assessment, hazard identification, fire safety, and related safety measures.
* Familiarity with data handling, reporting, and technical documentation.
* Experience working in multidisciplinary or team\-based projects.


Skills

* Initial experience in occupational safety and risk management, including assessing workplace activities, identifying hazards, and analysing risks.
* Knowledge of safety\-related projects in complex industrial or scientific facilities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to draft safety documentation and deliver oral presentations in at least one of CERN's two official languages (English or French).
* Proactive, organised, and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and work both independently and as part of a team.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a keen interest in safety, engineering, and project delivery.
* Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Join the team responsible for the High Throughput Compute systems at the heart of CERN's data processing!  

  

Are you a recent graduate with an interest in large\-scale computing, automation, and infrastructure technologies? Would you like to develop your skills while contributing to the evolution of the computing infrastructure supporting the High\-Luminosity LHC?  

  

As a member of the team responsible for the batch service and configuration management of IT services, you will have the opportunity to experience a varied role, from helping to automate the delivery of compute, to self healing infrastructure, to evolving the toolset that the IT department uses to manage its services.  

  

The Compute and Devices (CD) group in CERN IT provides a wide range of compute services, all the way from end user devices, through cloud infrastructure\-as\-a\- Service, machine\-learning, Kubernetes, configuration management, batch and HPC computing at CERN, together with a set of services that support the whole WLCG.  

  

As a member of the Compute and Configuration (CC) section of the CD group, you will join a team of engineers focusing on services supporting the physics community. We run the compute facility that comprises approximately 20% of the WLCG, using tools such as Puppet, OpenStack and Kubernetes to manage batch systems running HTCondor, HPC systems running SLURM, and the support services keeping everything glued together.  

  

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, contributing to open\-source software, and working with infrastructure at scale, come join us!

**Your responsibilities**

* Help manage the fleet of 400k\+ cores complete lifecycle from CI provisioning through automated and AI enhanced maintenance.
* Help keep us ahead of LLM enhanced security threats with monitoring.
* Suggest, test, and deploy configuration changes on a large scale to production.
* Contribute to the operation and maintenance of the current configuration management infrastructure, including Foreman, Puppet and OpenVox components.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of Terraform/OpenTofu modules used to provision and configure the supporting infrastructure.
* Improve the quality of the configuration code through testing, validation, code review and standardisation.

**Your profile**

* Experience administering or working with Linux systems in a server or data centre environment.
* Experience writing scripts or applications for automation or system tasks.
* Experience with configuration management tools such as Puppet or Ansible is a plus.
* Experience with container technologies, CI/CD systems or Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools is a plus.


Skills

* Knowledge of Linux, programming or scripting languages such as Python or Go.
* Familiarity with git for distributed version control is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of configuration management tools such as Puppet or Ansible is desirable.
* Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or OpenTofu would be a plus.
* Any knowledge of batch systems such as HTCondor, SLURM or kueue would be a plus.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.

### **Das bringst du für die Stelle mit**


* Du verfügst über eine höhere Ausbildung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung und bringst ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge mit
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau, Betrieb und der Weiterentwicklung komplexer System\- und Integrationslandschaften ermöglicht es dir, auch anspruchsvolle Herausforderungen erfolgreich zu meistern

* Idealerweise konntest du bereits Kenntnisse in SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder FSM sammeln und verstehst die Anforderungen moderner Unternehmensanwendungen

* Du vertrittst deine Position überzeugend und kannst dich durchsetzen
* Du fühlst dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT wohl und verstehst es, unterschiedliche Stakeholder für gemeinsame Lösungen an einen Tisch zu bringen
* Für diese Rolle bringst du sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit


### **Noch nicht überzeugt? V\-ZUG bietet dir mehr als nur einen Job**


Unsere Benefits

 Unsere Kultur

 Bewerbungsprozess


Als Teil der V\-ZUG Familie profitierst du von zeitgemässen Anstellungsbedingungen, vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, geeigneter Infrastruktur sowie zahlreichen Angeboten und Dienstleistungen für dein persönliches Wohlbefinden.


**In Zug arbeiten**


Du arbeitest dort, wo die Perfektion unserer Produkte tagtäglich spürbar ist – von der Produktentwicklung über die Produktion bis hin zum Vertrieb. Zudem profitierst du von der direkten Verkehrsanbindung für Bus, Bahn und Auto, einem Mobilitätsbeitrag und vergünstigten Parkplätzen. Auch das Vergnügen kommt nicht zu kurz: So geniesst du im eigenen Personalrestaurant ausgewogene Menüs oder entspannst bei einer Massage im Sitzen, beides zu vergünstigten Preisen.


**Flexibel arbeiten**


Wir fördern dein Wohlbefinden und deinen optimalen Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Freizeit. Innerhalb regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen und entsprechend den Anforderungen der Arbeitsaufgaben hast du als Mitarbeiter:in der V\-ZUG grösstmögliche Flexibilität. Egal, ob im Teilzeitmodell, Homeoffice oder Jobsharing – du arbeitest wann, wo und wie du am produktivsten bist.


**Profi bleiben**


Deine individuelle Entwicklung ist uns wichtig. Wir helfen dir dabei, deine Karriere durch kontinuierliche Aus\- und Weiterbildungen, inspirierende Mentorinnen und Mentoren und eine Vielzahl an geeigneten Lernressourcen zu perfektionieren. Weiter bestehen zahlreiche Aktivitäten für ein unfallfreies und gesundes Arbeitsumfeld. So bleibst du als Profi rundum fit – heute und morgen.


**Zusätzlich profitieren**


Wir leben durchs Band den Grundsatz der Gleichstellung. Neben einer marktgerechten und fairen Entlöhnung trumpfen wir mit überdurchschnittlichen Sozialleistungen. Da wir auf einen Koordinationsabzug verzichten, profitieren auch Mitarbeitende mit Teilzeitarbeit von unserer Vorsorgelösung.  

Eine weitere Selbstverständlichkeit ist für uns die vergünstigte Abgabe von V\-ZUG Produkten an dich und deine Familienangehörigen.  

Ausserdem stehen dir für deinen aktiven Ausgleich zur Arbeit vielfältige und attraktive Freizeitangebote zur Verfügung, bei welchen du von mehreren Vergünstigungen profitierst.


**Perspektiven erweitern**


Als Arbeitgeberin schaffen wir eine wertschätzende Arbeitskultur, welche Neugier, neue Herangehensweisen sowie fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch das Erlernen neuer Kompetenzen fördert. Bei V\-ZUG hast du die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft eines traditionsreichen Unternehmens voranzutreiben. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Gemeinsam leisten wir täglich einen Beitrag für unsere Vision „Wir bringen Leichtigkeit in Ihr Zuhause und Kreativität in Ihre Küche“. Darauf sind wir stolz.


**Teamgeist leben**


Wir stehen für eine bunte V\-ZUG ein, indem wir Rahmenbedingungen schaffen, um von der existierenden Diversität im Unternehmen gegenseitig profitieren zu können. Was uns alle verbindet, ist der Teamgeist und die Passion für die Marke V\-ZUG. Wir arbeiten eng und kollaborativ zusammen, vertrauen uns gegenseitig und begegnen unseren Mitmenschen mit Respekt und Interesse. Wir akzeptieren keinerlei Diskriminierung und sind überzeugt: Inklusion und Diversität machen unser Unternehmen stark und attraktiv. Jeder Einzelne und jede Einzelne trägt dazu bei, das „wir“ voranzubringen.


**Nachhaltigkeit vorantreiben**


Als Arbeitgeberin verstehen wir es als Pflicht, die Mitarbeitenden für die Nachhaltigkeit zu sensibilisieren. So lancierten wir unter anderem ein Training zum Thema „Nachhaltigkeit und Ressourcenknappheit“ und starteten die V\-ACT Challenge, bei welcher wir auf spielerische und aktivierende Art etwas Gutes für die Umwelt tun konnten. Darüber hinaus wurden sogenannte Awareness\-Ambassadors in den Teams ernannt, welche monatliche Schwerpunktthemen vermitteln. Solche Initiativen sind nicht zuletzt eine hervorragende Gelegenheit für unsere Mitarbeitenden, eigene Anregungen für mehr Nachhaltigkeit bei V\-ZUG einzubringen.

jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

### **About Xe**


Xe is a cross\-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.


Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross\-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real\-scale.

### **About This Role**


We're hiring a senior full\-stack engineer who owns real problems end\-to\-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and frontend experience through to backend services, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.


You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the platform across the stack, and lead delivery of customer\-facing features as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small engineering team with direct access to product, design, and compliance, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid\-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross\-domain decisions.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design and own features across the stack that move money and manage multi\-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
* Lead delivery of customer\-facing features that customers use every day, from the interface through to the services behind them.
* Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on\-call, and incident response.
* Lead cross\-functional delivery with product, design, and compliance from problem framing through launch.
* Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid\-level engineers.
* Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

### **What We're Looking For**

**Must\-have**

* 6 to 10\+ years building production web applications, end\-to\-end.
* Strong frontend proficiency with Vue.js, React, or equivalent.
* Strong backend proficiency in C\# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
* Solid SQL and relational database fundamentals.
* Writing and maintaining tests as part of how you ship.
* Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
* Production experience on AWS, including hands\-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
* Strong system design and architecture experience, including service\-oriented or microservices and event\-driven patterns.
* Payments, FX, or regulated\-industry experience.
* Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.
* Strong communication and collaboration across engineering, product, and design.

**Nice\-to\-have**

* Frontend fundamentals: responsive design, accessibility, web performance, and internationalization.
* Experience leading front\-end or platform modernization and migrations.
* Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
* Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
* Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
* Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

### **Perks \& Benefits**

* Annual performance\-related rewards: performance\-based annual bonus
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP): open to all employees
* Car allowance: monthly car allowance (subject to Direction Level)
* Meal vouchers: 8€ per working day
* Preferential currency exchange rates: exclusive rates for employees
* Money transfer discounts: special discounts on transfers
* Annual salary review: performance\-based process
* Hybrid working model: 2 days per week WFH with flexible scheduling
* Extended vacation allowance: 25\-30 days annual leave
* Extra bank holidays: additional company\-recognised holidays
* Birthday off: fully paid day off
* Annual employee recognition events: HEROES awards \& seniority recognitions
* Annual social events: end\-of\-year celebration \& regional/departmental gatherings
* Seasonal celebrations: Halloween, New Year, Christmas, and other festivities
* Volunteer days \& CSR initiatives: Save the Children, environmental actions, food bank donations, and more
* Employee wellness weeks: global and local wellbeing activities
* Leadership training: internal and external learning opportunities
* Cross\-functional project opportunities: available based on skills and project needs
* Internal \& international mobility: relocation support and coaching for career development


XE offers a competitive salary and benefits package. The reasonable estimated pay for this role ranges from 65,000 EUR to 80,000 EUR. Actual compensation is based upon factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.


We want Xe to be a great place to work and to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organization that encourages diversity in all respects.


Xe is an **Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, national origin, race, color, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@xe.com.

It is not to be taken as a complete statement of responsibilities or requirements. Responsibilities:

Our newest opportunity is for a talented **K2 Developer**, seconded to our Client from government sector in **Doha, Qatar**.  

This position is available on a **6\-month short\-term contract**, supporting the project’s immediate requirements in Dubai.  

The successful candidate will be designing, building, configuring, and maintaining enterprise\-grade business process applications using the K2 product suite (K2 Five / K2 Cloud / Nintex Automation). This role transforms manual, paper\-based, or fragmented workflows into streamlined, automated digital applications. The position collaborates with business analysts and IT teams to implement data models, user interfaces, and automated workflows that improve organizational efficiency, governance, and system connectivity.  

We envisage success in this role to include;  

K2 Application Architecture \& Design* **Workflow Modeling:** Translate complex business process maps into functional K2 automated workflows, utilizing advanced rules, inline functions, and conditional routing logic.
* **Smart Forms Development:** Design high\-fidelity, responsive user interfaces using K2 Smart Forms, incorporating custom views, controls, validation rules, and expressions.
* **Smart Objects Integration:** Create and configure reusable K2 Smart Objects to establish secure data handshakes between K2 applications and external databases or SaaS platforms.


Integration \& Core Engineering* **API \& System Integration:** Connect K2 workflows with core enterprise ecosystems (e.g., SharePoint, SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics) via REST/SOAP Web Services and custom Service Brokers.
* **Database Programming:** Write, optimize, and maintain underlying SQL Server database components, including stored procedures, views, and complex triggers tied to K2 processes.
* **Custom Code Extension:** Author custom .NET/C\# code snippets, custom assembly brokers, or custom Smart Forms controls to extend K2 platform capabilities when out\-of\-the\-box features fall short.


Maintenance, Administration \& Optimization* **Platform Administration:** Troubleshoot failed workflow instances, manage server logs, configure environmental string fields, and handle package deployments using K2 Management and K2 Package \& Deployment.
* **Performance Tuning:** Audit and refactor inefficient Smart Object queries and deeply nested Smart Form rules to minimize server\-side processing times and form load latches.
* **Technical Documentation:** Create and update Technical Design Documents (TDD), environment migration playbooks, and structural data dictionaries for all custom K2 builds


Qualifications:

To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include **5\+ years of professional software development experience, with a heavy emphasis on business process management (BPM) systems**, partnered with Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related quantitative field.  

Furthermore, you should demonstrate:* **Dedicated K2 Experience:** At least 3 to 5 years of hands\-on experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise applications explicitly built over K2 Five or K2 Cloud.
* **Enterprise Integration Track Record:** Proven experience successfully integrating K2 ecosystems with at least two standard enterprise architectures (such as SharePoint Online, Oracle, other ERP’s or Databases).
* **K2 Core Architecture:** Deep mastery of the K2 product suite (K2 Five or K2 Cloud), including K2 Designer, Smart Objects, Smart Forms, K2 Workflow, K2 Management, and K2 Workspace.
* **Database Programming:** Expert proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server, advanced T\-SQL scripting, writing optimized stored procedures, and complex views.
* **Software Development:** Strong programming foundations in .NET, C\#, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (useful for extending out\-of\-thebox Smart Forms).
* **K2 Specific Credentials:** Nintex/K2 Certified Specialist, K2 Five Core Developer, or Nintex Automation Cloud Practitioner/Developer certifications.
* **Microsoft Ecosystem Certifications:** Microsoft Certified: AzureDeveloper Associate or relevant legacy certificates in SQL Server / .NET development.


KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.


We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award\-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

Ofgem plays a vital role in the UKs energy system, protecting consumers and enabling a more secure, fair and sustainable energy future, and a robust Architecture capability is central to this mission.

Within the Digital, Data and Security Services (DDSS) directorate, we are modernising our technology estate and expanding our use of Microsoft Azure as a core platform. This includes building secure, scalable and cost\-effective solutions that support data, AI and digital services across the organisation.


As a Principal Technical Architect (Azure), you will play a key role in shaping how Azure is designed and used across Ofgem. You will define standards and governance, guide technical decision\-making and support delivery teams to build high\-quality cloud solutions. * Establishing and embedding architectural patterns, principles and governance

* Strong experience designing and delivering solutions on Microsoft Azure
* Solid understanding of cloud architecture, governance and optimisation

Across government, enterprise platforms such as Salesforce are central to delivering modern, user\-focused and data\-driven services. As platforms scale and become embedded in core business processes, strong technical leadership is essential to ensure stability, performance and continuous improvement. Ofgem plays a vital role in the UKs energy system, protecting consumers and enabling a more secure, fair and sustainable energy future, and the effective operation of its core digital platforms is critical to delivering this mission.


Ofgem is on an ambitious transformation journey. As a **Principal Developer (Salesforce)**, you will lead the technical strategy and operational management of Ofgems Salesforce environment. You will oversee development and administration teams, ensure high\-quality solution delivery and provide technical assurance across the platform. You will work closely with senior stakeholders, architects and suppliers to shape and optimise Salesforce services, ensuring they deliver consistent, reliable and high\-performing outcomes.


This is a senior, high\-impact leadership role requiring deep Salesforce expertise, strong operational oversight and the ability to influence across complex delivery environments.
